entries.prevention: Compare proof vector with current state only before transition; after persistence, validate it against the exact retained lifecycle/journal preimage record while separately enforcing current post-state vector and browser mirror, with a substituted post-authority negative.

entries.mistake: The first PS7 lifecycle fixture after FIX1 parser qualification rejected journal preparedUtc because the new exact-UTC validator and existing timestamp generator used different fractional-second wire formats. The agent stopped without retry or patch.
entries.rootCause: The browser-session timestamp validator was reused for journal history without round-tripping all existing journal timestamp producers.
entries.prevention: Use one explicit invariant formatter/parser contract for journal timestamps, cover prepared/committed/reconciled fields and new plus existing histories on both hosts, and add malformed/non-UTC negatives before wider FIX1 tests.

entries.mistake: The fresh PS7 persisted-browser fixture rejected producedUtc because raw proof timestamp text and ConvertFrom-Json-coerced retained runtime value were compared directly. The agent stopped without retry or patch.
entries.rootCause: Exact wire equality relied on host-dependent decoded JSON date runtime types instead of explicit invariant canonicalization and raw-token validation.
entries.prevention: Canonicalize accepted string/date runtime shapes to invariant UTC milliseconds, validate raw retained tokens when wire spelling matters, and add cross-host string/date/offset/precision/history fixtures.

entries.mistake: After PS7 parsing passed, the PRE-AAB-1 Windows parser wrapper exposed parser variables to an outer double-quoted command. Expansion produced an empty pipeline and WinPS rejected before the readiness parser or fixture ran.
entries.rootCause: Parser source crossed an interpolating nested PowerShell command boundary instead of using direct -File or a literal script block.
entries.prevention: Invoke the executable readiness owner directly with -File on each host when stable; for parse-only checks use a qualified literal script block with no interpolating outer layer.

entries.mistake: The PRE-AAB-3 agent issued an unclosed rg group while inspecting its checker. rg rejected the pattern and the agent stopped without retry, mutation or test.
entries.rootCause: A compound regex source-inspection pattern was not balanced or validated before execution.
entries.prevention: Prefer fixed-string source anchors; otherwise use one small literal balanced regex and validate it before execution rather than composing unreviewed alternation.

entries.mistake: The PRE-AAB-3 agent used multiple Update File operations for the same checker in one apply_patch payload. Verification rejected the duplicate target before mutation and the agent stopped without retry or test.
entries.rootCause: Several bounded hunks were expressed as repeated file operations rather than one update section or sequential patches.
entries.prevention: Use one Update File section per owner per patch with non-overlapping hunks; apply dependent hunks in separate patches with readback rather than repeating a target header.

entries.mistake: After PRE-AAB-3-FIX1 qualification, the agent sent a duplicate stability notice to an already completed transition agent and received agent thread limit reached. The active state owner already had the notice; no repository, test or external state was affected.
entries.rootCause: The sender did not check live agent status before a nonessential duplicate coordination message.
entries.prevention: Check agent status before messaging, avoid notices to completed agents unless starting a required new turn, and route stable hashes through the primary plus active dependents.

entries.mistake: The first PS7 readiness self-test injected premature build authority after a fixture advanced to manifest-bound precycle state. Readiness enforced the held zero-action vector only in original selection state, so the negative passed and the fixture failed.
entries.rootCause: Selection-only vector validation was keyed to one machine-state literal rather than every source-phase precycle state.
entries.prevention: Enforce all eight zero counts, all four held authorities and detailed/aggregate parity in each source precycle state, with wrong-count and premature-authority dual-host negatives.

entries.mistake: Independent source audit found caller-only success switches without retained source attestation, nonrecoverable sequential OPPO pair moves, permissive unknown evidence fields with incomplete privacy scanning and read paths that do not reject reparse ancestors. Fixtures were withheld and no external action occurred.
entries.rootCause: The producer batch treated sanitized summary generation as evidence provenance and validated common fields without a separate source-attestation, transaction or exact-schema trust boundary.
entries.prevention: Bind immutable source attestation path/hash/bytes/producer/session/nonce, journal and reconcile the OPPO pair, exact-allowlist schemas plus forbidden name/value shapes, reject every reparse ancestor and add dual-host injected failures for all boundaries.

entries.mistake: After source vector correction, the fresh PS7 readiness negative still allowed premature artifact/result/proof evidence in manifest-bound precycle state because absence checks remained selection-state-only. The agent stopped and WinPS did not run.
entries.rootCause: Source-precycle invariants were split between a general vector function and a selection-only evidence-absence function keyed to one machine state.
entries.prevention: Use one common source-precycle invariant for selection and manifest-bound states covering counts, authorities, artifact/provenance, results, browser/lifecycle proof, founder input and zero actions, with premature artifact/evidence/proof dual-host negatives.

entries.mistake: The independent transition auditor issued a compound Select-String regex ending in an invalid backslash escape. Pattern parsing failed and the auditor stopped without retry, test or mutation.
entries.rootCause: A compound escaped source-search regex was used for exact anchors without checking its terminal escape state.
entries.prevention: Use Select-String -SimpleMatch or fixed-string rg for source anchors; if regex is necessary, use one reviewed literal pattern and reject trailing escapes before invocation.

entries.mistake: Independent audit found non-composable blocker/transition browser schemas, shared-prefix rather than exact-run fixture confinement, silent journal sequence reset when files disappear and a fork negative masked by an invalid timestamp. Green dual-host fixtures missed these boundaries; no external action occurred.
entries.rootCause: Browser semantics were independently reimplemented across gates, fixture confinement was family-wide, journal absence was treated as an empty valid chain and negative fixtures accepted rejection without proving the intended failure class.
entries.prevention: Use one exact browser/source/ledger schema, exact resolved state fixture root, history/journal cardinality and sequence parity including missing files, and exact-class negatives with valid timestamps before dual-host phase qualification.

entries.mistake: The evidence-attestation parser wrapper exposed target variables inside an outer double-quoted pwsh -Command. Host expansion produced InvalidOperation and malformed foreach errors before any assigned owner parser ran.
entries.rootCause: Parser variables crossed an interpolating nested command boundary instead of direct -File or a literal target-owned script block.
entries.prevention: Run stable checkers directly with -File per host, or use one literal non-interpolating parser block per owner; never embed parser variables in outer double-quoted command text.

entries.mistake: The primary apply_patch result truncated while REG2790 was being registered, so mutation success was unknown until bounded read-only existence, parse and exact-cardinality checks confirmed it landed once.
entries.rootCause: A mutation result exceeded the available context and could not serve as accepted completion evidence.
entries.prevention: Stop all mutation after a truncated write result, resolve exact target truth with bounded read-only checks and never repeat an uncertain patch blindly.

entries.mistake: While already stopped, the evidence-attestation agent combined two scoped git diff reads with a semicolon in one shell command. It only displayed untracked work and changed no repository or external state.
entries.rootCause: Independent repository-facing diagnostics were composed into one shell call instead of preserving one scoped inspection per command.
entries.prevention: Issue one scoped repository-facing read per shell call and do not join independent diff or gate inspections with command separators.

entries.mistake: The primary agent guessed registry property regressionId instead of id, producing a false zero REG2790 count and blank tail, then inspected the last entry before registering the failed diagnostic. Both commands were read-only.
entries.rootCause: The registry entry schema was assumed, and a logically impossible exit-zero result was followed up before the failure-registration boundary was honored.
entries.prevention: Inspect parsed schema first, project exact property id, and register any impossible successful diagnostic before issuing a corrective query.

entries.mistake: While paused, the evidence-attestation agent passed positional wildcard paths such as scripts/check-release* and scripts/write-release* to rg. Windows rejected the path shape with OS error 123 before search; no state changed.
entries.rootCause: Shell-style path wildcards were supplied as positional rg paths on Windows instead of discovering exact files first.
entries.prevention: Use rg --files for bounded owner discovery and search exact discovered paths; never pass positional wildcard paths to rg on Windows.

entries.mistake: REG2790 referenced scripts/check-release-source-attestation-c34l.ps1 before that planned owner existed, and the implementation memory gate failed closed on the missing repository evidence path.
entries.rootCause: A future implementation owner was treated as retained regression evidence during incident registration.
entries.prevention: Registry evidence arrays contain only paths that exist at registration time; planned owners remain ticket text until exact creation readback.

entries.mistake: The REG2795 correction removed the future checker path from REG2790 but left it in REG2792 and REG2794. The defect was found before a gate retry and no owner action occurred.
entries.rootCause: The correction targeted the first rejected entry rather than inventorying all occurrences introduced by the same registration batch.
entries.prevention: Inventory every occurrence of a missing registry-evidence owner and correct all of them before the one fresh memory-gate run.

entries.mistake: The evidence-attestation agent guessed a REG2791 durable filename from the incident summary, Get-Content failed, and the agent stopped before discovery retry or mutation.
entries.rootCause: A newly registered regression ID was converted into a conventional filename rather than resolved from the exact file inventory.
entries.prevention: Resolve new regression documents with bounded rg --files numeric-ID discovery before reading; never guess their descriptive suffix.

entries.mistake: The FIX2 agent ran full git status --short --branch with a 20k output cap against the huge dirty tree. Its 6535-line/134925-token result truncated and no mutation followed.
entries.rootCause: A known huge workspace inventory was requested as one direct tool result instead of separating boundary confirmation from scoped owner inspection.
entries.prevention: Use exact full status only for boundary confirmation and explicit scoped status for assigned owners; do not require the huge inventory to fit a direct result.

entries.mistake: The FIX2 agent raw-read the 9878-line active handoff and the about 130308-token tool result truncated, leaving reconstruction incomplete. No mutation or test followed.
entries.rootCause: A dense append-only handoff was treated as one readable output rather than a current-heading lookup plus bounded nonoverlapping pages.
entries.prevention: Find the current checkpoint with fixed-string bounded search and read only the required section in small nonoverlapping pages through its continuation list.

entries.mistake: The FIX2 transition agent raw-read the 2715-line/189702-byte development regression memory and its about 47426-token projection truncated despite a nominal 60k cap. No mutation or test followed.
entries.rootCause: A dense append-only memory owner was treated as one output instead of an explicitly paged document.
entries.prevention: Read the regression memory in small independent nonoverlapping pages through exact EOF; never rely on a large nominal output cap.

entries.mistake: The first PS7 attestation checker passed a generated hashtable through an array subexpression instead of named-argument splatting, so EvidenceType parameter binding failed before attestation behavior. Cleanup ran and no real/external action occurred.
entries.rootCause: A generated argument map was treated as a positional array element at the invocation boundary.
entries.prevention: Assign generated maps to named local variables, use explicit hashtable splatting, and statically reject the array-subexpression call shape before the fresh run.

entries.mistake: The FIX2 agent raw-read the 1566-line/74695-byte transition owner and its about 18675-token projection was marked truncated despite a nominal 30k cap. No mutation or test followed.
entries.rootCause: A dense assigned owner was treated as one direct output instead of an explicitly paged source document.
entries.prevention: Read dense assigned PowerShell owners in independent nonoverlapping pages of at most 100 lines through verified EOF; never raw-read them.

entries.mistake: The first fresh PS7 OPPO transaction fixture rejected allowed versionName 1.0.0-r60.76 because a broad unanchored three-segment JWT regex treated it as a token. Fixture cleanup ran and real/external actions stayed zero.
entries.rootCause: Token detection used an unanchored generic dotted-segment pattern over all serialized public values instead of a field-aware plausible JWT shape.
entries.prevention: Use field-aware token scanning with anchored plausible base64url JWT length/shape, keep exact-schema private negatives, and add a canonical version-name allow fixture.

entries.mistake: The second fresh PS7 attestation fixture rejected canonical producedUtc after ConvertFrom-Json coerced the wire string to DateTime and a string cast lost the .fffZ spelling. Cleanup ran and real/external actions stayed zero.
entries.rootCause: Exact wire-format timestamp validation was performed on a host-coerced runtime object instead of separating semantic instant normalization from raw JSON token validation.
entries.prevention: Normalize string/DateTime/DateTimeOffset to invariant .fffZ and separately assert exact raw JSON timestamp token spelling and cardinality.

entries.mistake: The fresh PS7 OPPO transaction fixture rejected exact required action-count field passwordlessEmailSend because a generic forbidden-name substring scan treated its canonical email token as private. Cleanup ran and real/external actions stayed zero.
entries.rootCause: Generic private-name scanning was applied to exact-authoritative schema names without a field-aware canonical-name boundary.
entries.prevention: Validate exact schemas first, exempt only passwordlessEmailSend in the approved actionCounts position, and retain rejection for every unknown/private name or value elsewhere.

entries.mistake: OPPO reconciliation reparsed cold evidence, PS7 coerced nested sourceAttestation.producedUtc to DateTime, and exact string comparison falsely rejected the binding. Cleanup ran and real/external actions stayed zero.
entries.rootCause: Nested retained timestamp equality compared host runtime string representations instead of canonical UTC instants while wire identity was already hash-bound.
entries.prevention: Normalize string/DateTime/DateTimeOffset nested values to invariant .fffZ for semantic equality while retaining raw-token and file hash/byte wire validation.

entries.mistake: The injected attestation type negative rejected at an earlier leaf/specification mismatch because the invocation EvidenceType was derived from the mutated capture, masking the intended capture-type identity failure. Cleanup ran and external actions stayed zero.
entries.rootCause: The negative fixture mutated both the retained subject and the expected invocation contract instead of holding the oracle fixed.
entries.prevention: Keep invocation EvidenceType fixed to play_internal_testing_activation, mutate only the capture field, and require the exact intended rejection class.

entries.mistake: OPPO replay parsed its transaction journal, PS7 coerced canonical preparedUtc to DateTime, and casting it to string falsely rejected the valid wire time. Cleanup ran and real/external actions stayed zero.
entries.rootCause: Journal timestamp ordering reused a host-coerced string representation instead of raw canonical JSON tokens or normalized runtime objects.
entries.prevention: Retain raw journal JSON, assert one canonical prepared/committed UTC token, and use validated tokens or runtime normalization for interval ordering; never string-cast coerced timestamps as wire evidence.

entries.mistake: The first WinPS attestation checker completed 3 positives and 11 exact negatives, then Remove-Item on its fixture junction raised NullReferenceException in finally. The host run is not accepted; no real/external action occurred.
entries.rootCause: Windows PowerShell 5.1 recursive item cleanup was used directly on a reparse junction instead of unlinking the exact junction nonrecursively first.
entries.prevention: Verify the exact checker-owned junction, unlink it with nonrecursive DirectoryInfo.Delete, remove only the confirmed unique fixture root, and assert complete cleanup without traversing reparse links.

entries.mistake: The OPPO source-attestation tamper negative rejected at derived coldStart payload binding before the intended root journal sourceAttestation SHA mismatch, masking the provenance failure class. Cleanup ran and real/external actions stayed zero.
entries.rootCause: Journal validation checked derived payload identities before their root provenance binding, so one tamper changed both and the less-specific class won.
entries.prevention: Validate journal root source-attestation path/hash/bytes before derived cold/retained payload bindings and retain an independent payload-tamper negative.

entries.mistake: The exact-leftover cleanup script still contained recursive Remove-Item, so command policy rejected it before process launch. No junction unlink or filesystem mutation occurred.
entries.rootCause: The cleanup implementation retained a policy-blocked recursive cmdlet instead of using the already required exact DirectoryInfo deletion API end to end.
entries.prevention: Verify and unlink the exact junction with DirectoryInfo.Delete(), delete only the verified unique checker root with DirectoryInfo.Delete(true), and assert absence without Remove-Item.

entries.mistake: The attestation agent formatted four final SHA-256 values with Format-Table -AutoSize, which ellipsized every hash and made the output inadmissible. No state changed.
entries.rootCause: Width-dependent table rendering was used for exact cryptographic identity evidence.
entries.prevention: Emit one plain relativePath=FULL_SHA256;bytes=N;lines=N record per owner without table formatting or truncation-prone rendering.

entries.mistake: The FIX2 agent guessed an unrelated durable filename for REG2812, Get-Content failed, and no mutation/test followed.
entries.rootCause: A registry ID notification omitted the exact document path and the receiver inferred the suffix instead of discovering it.
entries.prevention: Send exact new regression paths with generation notices; otherwise resolve numeric IDs with bounded rg --files and never guess descriptive suffixes.

entries.mistake: The attestation agent sent a nonessential final compatibility notice to an already completed OPPO agent and coordination returned agent thread limit reached. Work/tests were complete and no repository/external state changed.
entries.rootCause: Peer liveness was not checked before a post-completion coordination message.
entries.prevention: Check live-agent status before nonessential notices and route completed-peer compatibility identities through the primary handoff.

entries.mistake: The first PS7 FIX2 lifecycle fixture rejected a contiguous sanitizedPath static token even though the implementation validation was present across a line break. No retry or external action followed.
entries.rootCause: A source assertion depended on whitespace/line wrapping instead of durable semantic anchors.
entries.prevention: Assert property access, comparison semantics and exact route literal as separate durable tokens; use behavioral negatives for wrong path/host acceptance.

entries.mistake: The duplicate-chain negative reached the correct transition rejection, but its checker expected a manually rephrased error literal. Both lifecycle hosts had passed; no retry or write followed.
entries.rootCause: Exact-class expected text was manually transcribed instead of bound to the authoritative transition literal.
entries.prevention: Use the exact authoritative rejection constant/literal without rephrasing and preserve the separate no-write assertion.

entries.mistake: The browser-readiness parser wrapper exposed variables inside outer double-quoted pwsh -Command text, causing host expansion and false pass output. No owner parser result or external action is accepted.
entries.rootCause: Parser variables crossed an interpolating nested command boundary and the wrapper printed success independently of a valid target error collection.
entries.prevention: Run stable owners directly with -File or one literal target-owned parser block and emit pass only after the target process proves its parser-error collection empty.

entries.mistake: The first fresh PS7 retained fixture rejected an approved AAB artifactPath as phone-shaped because canonical path/version digits matched a generic phone scan. Only a unique fixture root was touched; real/external actions stayed zero.
entries.rootCause: Phone detection was not field-aware for exact approved canonical path properties after schema validation.
entries.prevention: Exempt only exact approved path/hash/version/count fields in their schema positions, retain private/contact phone rejection elsewhere, and add canonical-path allow plus private-phone exact-class negatives.

entries.mistake: The strengthened exact browser-proof schema rejected injected raw nonce as an unknown field before the intended raw-session-nonce privacy class, so the exact-class fixture failed. Cleanup ran and external actions stayed zero.
entries.rootCause: General exact-schema rejection ran before the more specific forbidden-secret boundary.
entries.prevention: Reject explicit raw-secret names/values before general unknown fields, then enforce exact schema; keep separate benign-unknown and raw-nonce exact-class negatives.

entries.mistake: After removing obsolete qualification constants for the exact 23-field schema, one traversal negative still referenced unset expectedBrowserQualificationPath and StrictMode stopped the fresh PS7 run. Cleanup ran and external actions stayed zero.
entries.rootCause: Interface-field removal did not include a complete static inventory of the deleted symbol's fixture references.
entries.prevention: Inventory every deleted symbol reference before testing and implement traversal coverage with a concrete sibling fixture-run proof path derived inside the unique fixture family.

entries.mistake: The retained fixture reached wrong-digest-keys but its captured rejection did not match the expected class; the helper omitted the observed message, so diagnosis/retry/mutation stopped. Only unique fixtures were touched.
entries.rootCause: The exact-class fixture or validation order diverged, and its diagnostic helper did not expose sanitized observed output for bounded diagnosis.
entries.prevention: Include sanitized observed rejection in exact-class helper failures, perform one bounded diagnostic after registration, and preserve separate wrong-key and wrong-value negatives.

entries.mistake: A retained-checker correction combined three distant hunks with transcribed expected-label ordering that did not match the live file. apply_patch rejected atomically and no retry followed.
entries.rootCause: Distant fixture edits relied on remembered context instead of fresh exact local anchors.
entries.prevention: Read fresh bounded line slices and use one separately anchored patch per local section; never combine distant edits under transcribed context.

entries.mistake: The retained/privacy agent passed two guessed nonexistent build-owner paths to rg during recovery-schema review. rg reported path-not-found, other matches were not accepted, and no mutation/test followed.
entries.rootCause: Likely build-owner filenames were inferred instead of discovered from the exact repository inventory.
entries.prevention: Use bounded rg --files owner discovery first and search only verified literal paths; never guess build wrapper or launcher filenames.

entries.mistake: The fresh retained fixture rejected authorized public branch remediation/prototype-conformance-2026-07-20 as phone-shaped. Only a synthetic fixture root was touched and no retry/external action followed.
entries.rootCause: Generic phone scanning was applied to the exact canonical build-provenance branch value after schema validation.
entries.prevention: Exempt only the canonical build-provenance branch field from phone-shape scanning while enforcing its exact authorized value; retain private/contact phone negatives elsewhere.

entries.mistake: WinPS retained canonical builtAt as a string and generic phone scanning rejected its digits, while PS7 had coerced the same value to DateTime and bypassed the string scan. PS7 passed; no retry/external action followed.
entries.rootCause: Privacy scanning depended on host-specific JSON timestamp runtime shape instead of an exact field-aware UTC contract.
entries.prevention: Validate builtAt with exact canonical UTC grammar plus semantic normalization on both hosts, exempt only that validated position from phone scanning, and cover raw-string/coerced shapes.

entries.mistake: The fresh WinPS retained run rejected valid wrapper-format builtAt 2026-08-17T05:30:00.0000000+05:30 before negatives. The agent stopped with no diagnostic/retry/external action.
entries.rootCause: The new exact round-trip parser helper or its WinPS overload rejected an authoritative valid offset instant; precise cause remains pending bounded inspection.
entries.prevention: Prove invariant DateTimeOffset round-trip grammar and parsing directly on both hosts, with separate valid +05:30, valid Z, malformed and ambiguous-offset fixtures before suite retry.

entries.mistake: The first direct WinPS timestamp proof exposed formats/wire/parsed variables inside outer double-quoted -Command text, producing malformed target code and no proof. No file/external action changed.
entries.rootCause: Diagnostic variables crossed an interpolating nested process-command boundary.
entries.prevention: Use a target-owned fixture script invoked directly with -File on each host or a fully literal command block; never embed diagnostic variables in outer double-quoted arguments.

entries.mistake: The direct WinPS retained suite executed all fixtures but final inventory failed at index zero because builtAt negatives ran first while their labels were inserted later in a separate expected array. No retry/external action followed.
entries.rootCause: Fixture execution order and a separately maintained oracle-label order diverged.
entries.prevention: Keep one ordered fixture definition or append labels at execution time, then assert exact count, uniqueness and sequence without a separately transcribed array.

entries.mistake: The final PS7 combined-producer run failed while WinPS passed because its OPPO journal lacked exactly one canonical preparedUtc wire token. Independent OPPO dual-host transaction tests had passed; no diagnosis/retry/external action followed.
entries.rootCause: The combined fixture likely synthesized or reparsed OPPO journal wire data differently across hosts instead of reusing the qualified transaction interface; precise cause remains pending bounded inspection.
entries.prevention: Inspect only combined fixture journal construction/raw token, reuse the qualified OPPO transaction interface, and assert prepared/committed raw-token cardinality before writer invocation.

entries.mistake: Direct and ordinary self-nested OPPO suites passed, but PS7 combined still failed because the new probe omitted the preceding source-attestation checker call in the same caller scope. No WinPS retry; cleanup ran and real/external/private actions stayed zero.
entries.rootCause: The correction qualified generic nesting rather than the exact two-step caller-scope sequence that triggers REG2829.
entries.prevention: Reproduce source-attestation checker then OPPO checker in one caller scope and retain only sanitized token type/cardinality diagnostics while preserving raw-wire enforcement.

entries.mistake: The independent evidence auditor ran full git status --short --branch against the huge dirty tree; its about 143470-token output truncated at the direct cap and no later audit command followed.
entries.rootCause: A known huge workspace inventory was requested as one direct result instead of separating boundary confirmation from scoped owner status.
entries.prevention: Use the exact full command only for branch-boundary confirmation, then explicit scoped status for audited owners; never depend on the complete huge body fitting one result.

entries.mistake: The transition-attestation agent ran full git status --short --branch and its about 143491-token dirty-tree body truncated. Scalar branch/HEAD remained exact and no mutation/test followed.
entries.rootCause: A known huge workspace inventory was requested as one direct result before switching to scoped owner status.
entries.prevention: Use full status only as boundary signal, verify branch/HEAD independently, and inspect only explicit assigned-owner status paths.

entries.mistake: The transition-attestation agent raw-read the dense development regression memory and its about 47426-token output truncated. No retry/mutation/test followed.
entries.rootCause: The fixed dense memory owner was treated as one direct output instead of a paged document.
entries.prevention: Read the memory in independent nonoverlapping pages of at most 250 lines through exact EOF, then run the gate alone; never raw-read it.

entries.mistake: The independent evidence auditor raw-read the 9878-line active handoff and its about 130308-token result truncated. No later command or mutation followed.
entries.rootCause: A dense append-only handoff was treated as one output rather than a bounded current-checkpoint source.
entries.prevention: Find the current 18:20 checkpoint heading with fixed-string search and read only that section/continuation in nonoverlapping pages of at most 80 lines; do not page all history.

entries.mistake: The independent evidence auditor read the full 1005-line OPPO writer in one result; about 10894 tokens truncated inside its trust boundary. No later command/test/mutation followed.
entries.rootCause: A dense security-sensitive owner was requested as one direct result instead of bounded source pages.
entries.prevention: Read the OPPO writer in independent nonoverlapping pages of at most 200 lines through verified EOF and never accept truncated source as complete audit evidence.

entries.mistake: The independent evidence auditor read the full retained gate in one result and a 396-token block inside Assert-C34LSourceAttestation truncated. No later command/test/mutation followed.
entries.rootCause: A dense trust-boundary owner was still treated as one output with a larger cap instead of explicitly paged source.
entries.prevention: Page this and all remaining owners over about 400 lines in independent nonoverlapping chunks of at most 160 lines through verified EOF.

entries.mistake: Independent audit found caller-fabricable source captures, raw deviceSerial retention, incomplete lifecycle-proof binding, single-backslash/privacy-name gaps, missing fixture cleanup, shadow-only recovery tests and two uncovered OPPO post-move/pre-journal crash windows. Behavioral gates were withheld and no external action occurred.
entries.rootCause: FIX1 bound self-described manifests and summary files but did not bind each claimed capture digest to an immutable retained source artifact, and several validators/fixtures proved local shapes rather than the full production trust boundary.
entries.prevention: Require immutable capture artifact path/SHA/bytes per digest and exact producer/type contract; use nonreversible device binding; compare full newest proof and both histories; correct path/privacy checks; deterministic cleanup; confined real recovery audit/apply; and cover both post-move/pre-journal windows dual-host.

entries.mistake: The OPPO FIX2 agent ran full git status --short --branch and its about 143659-token dirty-tree output truncated before scoped owner status. No file changed.
entries.rootCause: A known huge workspace inventory was requested as one direct result instead of boundary scalars plus scoped owner status.
entries.prevention: Use full status as boundary-only, verify branch/HEAD independently, and inspect only the two exact assigned OPPO owner paths.

entries.mistake: The transition FIX2 raw-device correction combined distant OPPO/journey hunks with remembered wrapped schema context; apply_patch rejected atomically and no hunk applied.
entries.rootCause: Distant schema edits relied on transcribed field-list wrapping instead of fresh exact local anchors.
entries.prevention: Read bounded live OPPO and journey regions and apply one separately anchored patch per region; never combine distant schema edits under remembered context.

entries.mistake: The OPPO FIX2 agent projected registry tail with guessed regressionId instead of id, yielding null tail IDs while count/hash remained valid. No schema retry or mutation followed.
entries.rootCause: An already established registry entry property was guessed again instead of reused from REG2793/schema truth.
entries.prevention: Project exact property id and treat null tail IDs as a failed diagnostic; never guess registry entry property names.

entries.mistake: The OPPO FIX2 agent guessed a topic-based REG2839 filename and Get-Content failed even though the exact path was supplied. REG2840 read succeeded; no mutation/test followed.
entries.rootCause: A supplied durable filename was replaced with an inferred topic-based name.
entries.prevention: Copy exact paths from primary notices verbatim or discover by numeric ID with bounded rg --files; never substitute a likely filename.

entries.mistake: The initial FIX2 contract assigned Play, OPPO and journey one immutable capture-manifest path even though they have different lifecycle preimages, producers and role schemas. Cross-owner review found it before producer/OPPO mutation.
entries.rootCause: Attempt-level confinement was modeled as one owner instead of a parent containing three immutable evidence-kind owners.
entries.prevention: Use exact per-kind play/oppo/journey directories, each with its own capture manifest/artifacts, journey rows under journey/journeys, bind the revised contract hash and reject cross-kind aliasing.

entries.mistake: The first PS7 parser gate over the two OPPO FIX2 owners reported missing closing parenthesis/brace and unexpected closing tokens; the aggregate diagnostic omitted file/extent. No behavior or external action followed.
entries.rootCause: A bounded owner edit introduced an unmatched delimiter and the parser wrapper did not retain sufficient exact location evidence.
entries.prevention: Emit exact owner/line/column/errorId/sanitized extent once, correct only the smallest delimiter region, and parse each owner independently before behavior.

entries.mistake: A combined validation command parsed successfully then treated the intended zero-match rg inventory as failure because exit 1 was unguarded. No behavior ran or later file changed.
entries.rootCause: An authoritative parser and an expected-zero diagnostic search were composed under one exit status.
entries.prevention: Run parser and obsolete-reference search separately; interpret rg exit 1 as success only after independently asserting empty output.

entries.mistake: The first capture FIX2 parser wrapper used a colon immediately after interpolated $file, so the wrapper itself failed before any mutated owner parser ran. Existing owner edits remain untested.
entries.rootCause: Diagnostic interpolation reused the known colon-after-unbraced-variable parser hazard.
entries.prevention: Use the format operator or braced variables for diagnostics and parse each owner independently; never place punctuation immediately after an unbraced variable.

entries.mistake: The bounded OPPO parser diagnostic piped from a statement-level foreach block into ConvertTo-Json, causing an empty-pipe parser error before owner parsing. No retry followed.
entries.rootCause: Loop collection and serialization were composed as one invalid PowerShell pipeline.
entries.prevention: Assign loop results to a collection and serialize separately, or parse one owner per command; never pipe directly from statement-level foreach.

entries.mistake: The first PS7 lifecycle suite rejected broad substring uninstall although the exact schema intentionally validates uninstallPerformed=false. No transition retry or external action followed.
entries.rootCause: A broad action-word source ban conflated a false-valued evidence property with an executable uninstall action.
entries.prevention: Ban exact executable/cmdlet action anchors and assert behavioral zero actions; allow and validate explicit false-valued evidence properties.

entries.mistake: The duplicate/cross-kind artifact-role negative rejected earlier because its mutated attestation lacked one canonical producedUtc wire token. The intended class was masked; cleanup ran and real/device/external/private actions stayed zero.
entries.rootCause: The role-only negative rebuilt or reparsed source attestation wire data without preserving exact raw UTC token spelling/cardinality.
entries.prevention: Preserve raw UTC tokens, mutate only the targeted role/path field, assert token cardinality before writer call, and retain separate UTC-wire and role negatives.

entries.mistake: The second PS7 lifecycle run rejected sanitized c34l-play-session-00000001 as phone-shaped because of trailing digits. Cleanup ran and external/private/device actions stayed zero.
entries.rootCause: Generic phone scanning was applied to an exact approved public sessionId schema position.
entries.prevention: Validate exact sessionId grammar first, exempt only that position from phone scanning, retain private/contact phone negatives, and cover valid digit-bearing sessions.

entries.mistake: The first PS7 source-attestation FIX2 positive rejected exact action-count name passwordlessEmailSend as private because it contains email. Parsers passed, cleanup ran, and real/external/private actions stayed zero.
entries.rootCause: Generic forbidden-property scanning ran without an exact schema-position boundary for authoritative action/authority member names.
entries.prevention: Validate exact schemas and allow the exact eight action-count/four authority names only in approved positions, while rejecting unknown/private-shaped names elsewhere.

entries.mistake: The fresh PS7 lifecycle run failed one aggregate attestation identity/preimage/vector/artifact/session assertion after privacy passed, but the message did not identify the field. Cleanup ran and no retry/external action followed.
entries.rootCause: Multiple trust-boundary field classes were collapsed into one opaque assertion.
entries.prevention: Perform one sanitized field-by-field diagnosis and replace aggregate checks with field-class-specific errors for identity, preimage, vector, artifact and session.

entries.mistake: The PS7 capture checker yielded a live session after 30s, but the wrapper emitted only output and discarded session_id/exit metadata. Empty visible output is zero evidence; no retry/mutation followed.
entries.rootCause: The orchestration wrapper projected only output instead of retaining the full long-running command result and session handle.
entries.prevention: Preserve full exec results, poll returned session IDs to completion, and after a lost handle probe only the exact checker process before any controlled orphan termination/rerun.

entries.mistake: The expanded PS7 lifecycle suite passed new FIX2 negatives through wrong device, then proof-history evidencePath mutation rejected outside the expected history class. Actual message was not retained; no retry/external action followed.
entries.rootCause: The negative may alter more than the targeted binding or validation order masks the intended proof/history class; the helper omitted the sanitized actual rejection.
entries.prevention: Capture sanitized actual once, hold all other fields valid, and give exact history equality and newest proof evidencePath checks deterministic distinct errors with separate negatives.

entries.mistake: The preserved-handle PS7 source checker ran about five minutes with zero output/no exit, then exact session 70395 was interrupted as authorized and exited 1 empty. No diagnosis/retry/mutation followed.
entries.rootCause: The FIX2 checker has an unresolved recursion, child wait, traversal or loop with no progress boundary; precise cause remains pending bounded diagnosis.
entries.prevention: Diagnose recursion/waits/traversal/loops once, add sanitized phase progress and finite timeout boundaries, correct the exact hang, and rerun under a preserved handle.

entries.mistake: The transition parser orchestration wrapper contained an unclosed text( template call, so the JavaScript tool layer rejected it before PowerShell execution. No mutation/test followed.
entries.rootCause: A custom result-projection template was syntactically incomplete.
entries.prevention: Use minimal balanced text(result.output) projection and one plain owner parser command per tool call instead of custom wrapper composition.

entries.mistake: The preStateSha256 negative reparsed/reserialized attestation JSON, PS7 changed producedUtc wire spelling, and UTC validation masked the intended preimage class. Cleanup ran and external/private/device actions stayed zero.
entries.rootCause: A single-field raw-wire negative used typed JSON round-trip that changed an unrelated timestamp token.
entries.prevention: Assert one exact target token and substitute only the raw hash literal without JSON reserialization; keep a separate UTC-wire negative.

entries.mistake: After PS7 passed 3 positives/22 negatives, the first WinPS run failed positive journey row-set validation while earlier positives passed. Cleanup ran; no diagnosis/retry/external action followed.
entries.rootCause: Top-level JSON array enumeration likely produced a host-specific runtime shape that the journey row validator did not normalize.
entries.prevention: Use an explicit cross-host top-level array normalization helper and assert exactly six unique ordered row objects with no nested/singleton ambiguity.

entries.mistake: An existing journal negative now rejects at the newly required retained detailed/aggregate history equality check before its old expected journal class. Cleanup ran and no retry/external action followed.
entries.rootCause: Validation order strengthened but the existing fixture setup/oracle was not classified against the new earlier invariant.
entries.prevention: Identify the exact fixture label, align only its setup/oracle, and retain separate deterministic history-equality and later journal-class negatives.

entries.mistake: After stable source checker, PS7 OPPO child found preparedUtc quoted once but canonical zero with runtime DateTime, while isolated child suites were green. No WinPS retry or external action followed.
entries.rootCause: At least one journal save serializes a caller-scope-coerced typed date instead of a fresh canonical wire string DTO.
entries.prevention: Canonicalize every journal UTC field before each save, serialize a fresh exact wire DTO, and assert raw token cardinality after every write in isolated and preceded scopes on both hosts.

entries.mistake: The capture FIX2 agent guessed docs/quality/regression-registry.json, Get-Content failed and local registryCount became false zero. No mutation followed.
entries.rootCause: The authoritative config registry path was replaced with an inferred docs path.
entries.prevention: Use config/codex-development-regression-registry.json exactly and project count/hash only after successful parse.

entries.mistake: WinPS lifecycle completed 11 positives/32 negatives then Remove-Item on a fixture junction raised NullReferenceException in finally. The run is not accepted; unique residue may remain and no retry followed.
entries.rootCause: Windows PowerShell recursive item cleanup was used directly on a reparse junction.
entries.prevention: Verify the exact link ReparsePoint, unlink nonrecursively with .NET Directory API, remove only verified target/run root, and assert absence without Remove-Item on the junction.

entries.mistake: The capture FIX2 agent guessed C:/Program Files/PowerShell/7/pwsh.exe and the command was not recognized before the memory script started. No cleanup/test/mutation followed.
entries.rootCause: A PowerShell installation path was hardcoded instead of using the qualified workspace command resolution.
entries.prevention: Use bare pwsh for PS7 and powershell.exe for WinPS; never hardcode installation paths.

entries.mistake: A standalone exact prior fixture-root cleanup command was blocked by policy before execution. The root remains unchanged; no retry/test/later mutation followed, while the checker cleanup patch had already applied.
entries.rootCause: Recursive cleanup was attempted as a standalone command after a failed fixture rather than being contained in an approved exact fixture owner.
entries.prevention: Fresh checkers clean only their own exact roots with verified nonrecursive junction unlink; preserve prior orphan for primary inventory and remove only via an explicitly approved exact cleanup owner.

entries.mistake: The capture FIX2 agent guessed an unrelated REG2863 filename and Get-Content failed even though the exact path was supplied. No gate/cleanup/mutation followed.
entries.rootCause: A supplied durable filename was replaced with a topic-derived guess.
entries.prevention: Copy supplied exact paths verbatim or discover by numeric ID with bounded rg --files; never substitute inferred filenames.

entries.mistake: Five parser invocations used outer double-quoted pwsh -Command text, host-expanded parser variables and all failed at an empty pipe before owner parsing. No owner mutation resulted.
entries.rootCause: The same interpolating nested parser payload was reused across parallel owner calls.
entries.prevention: Use current-host Parser.ParseFile per owner or stable direct -File checkers; never nest parser variables in interpolating command strings.

entries.mistake: The patch call registering REG2865 returned a truncated tool result, so its mutation outcome was unknown at the command boundary.
entries.rootCause: The mutation result was allowed through an output path whose wrapper could project an oversized response.
entries.prevention: Perform bounded exact target readback after every truncated mutation result and never retry blindly; require compact patch acknowledgements.

entries.mistake: A registry projection searched for shortened REG2865 and guessed nonexistent top-level count/hash properties, producing false zero and unusable values.
entries.rootCause: Summarized labels were substituted for the exact registry schema and full durable entry ID.
entries.prevention: Compare exact full entry ids, use entries.Count and compute the file SHA separately; inspect the exact parsed tail before registration.

entries.mistake: The transition agent piped directly from a statement-level foreach into ConvertTo-Json and the final identity projection failed before collecting hashes.
entries.rootCause: The known unsupported foreach-to-pipeline construction was reused in final evidence collection.
entries.prevention: Assign loop output before serialization or emit one exact owner identity per independent command.

entries.mistake: A double-quoted rg regex expanded source variables and became malformed before retained-owner inspection.
entries.rootCause: Source tokens containing dollar signs were placed in an interpolating diagnostic regex.
entries.prevention: Use single-quoted literal patterns or separate fixed-string searches for source tokens.

entries.mistake: The transition privacy validator approved sessionId values by leaf name alone, allowing the exemption to apply in arbitrary capture-artifact JSON outside approved source/capture positions.
entries.rootCause: A phone-pattern false-positive correction was implemented as a global leaf-name exemption instead of a position-specific schema exemption.
entries.prevention: Approve session grammar only at exact source-attestation, capture-manifest, or nested sourceAttestation.sessionId positions; reject capture-artifact root sessionId and rerun both transition suites on both hosts.

entries.mistake: The combined producer gate reached the retained child, which rejected valid FIX2 OPPO evidence because it still required legacy deviceSerial instead of approved deviceBindingSha256.
entries.rootCause: Concurrent producer and retained owners were tested before the retained owner had converged on the final nonraw device contract.
entries.prevention: Require and bind deviceBindingSha256, forbid all raw device fields in retained/recovery, publish a stable retained identity, then rerun the combined gate on both hosts.

entries.mistake: A double-quoted rg expression expanded source variables and became an invalid unclosed regex before transition inspection.
entries.rootCause: Source dollar-variable tokens were placed in an interpolating search pattern.
entries.prevention: Use separate single-quoted fixed-string searches for source tokens.

entries.mistake: Retained fixtures and a final-proof expectation used journeys-accepted while the authoritative lifecycle transition and proof output use device-accepted for the journey phase.
entries.rootCause: The old retained gate did not validate transition identity, allowing a locally copied fixture label to drift from the transition owner's exact contract.
entries.prevention: Bind retained transition names to the authoritative transition owner, require device-accepted, add a wrong-transition negative, and qualify both hosts.

entries.mistake: The combined producer fixture still emitted placeholder evidencePath and sha256 values instead of binding each newest lifecycle proof to the actual retained evidence owner.
entries.rootCause: Capture provenance was repaired without removing the legacy combined-fixture placeholder already identified by REG2837.
entries.prevention: Create each proof after the writer result exists, bind its exact evidence path and SHA, add wrong-owner negatives, and preserve detailed/aggregate proof-history equality.

entries.mistake: The retained agent replaced the supplied exact REG2874 path with a shortened topic-derived filename and Get-Content failed.
entries.rootCause: A supplied durable path was not copied verbatim.
entries.prevention: Use supplied exact paths; otherwise discover by numeric ID with bounded rg --files and never infer filenames.

entries.mistake: The independent audit combined a 30-line registry head and 500-line tail, producing a truncated result with an omitted middle portion.
entries.rootCause: An oversized textual registry projection was used instead of parsed exact entries or bounded pages.
entries.prevention: Project parsed exact entries or read independent nonoverlapping pages of at most 120 lines.

entries.mistake: A recovery patch included an unrelated absent trailing FixtureMode anchor and was rejected atomically.
entries.rootCause: A speculative second context anchor was combined with the exact confinement edit.
entries.prevention: Patch only the freshly read immediate stateFile confinement block in one bounded owner hunk.

entries.mistake: The C34L detailed selection state and final transition identity retained and required raw candidate.deviceSerial despite the FIX2 nonraw device-binding contract.
entries.rootCause: Producer evidence migrated to deviceBindingSha256 while the earlier state schema and transition common identity were omitted from the migration.
entries.prevention: Replace raw state identity with the approved deviceBindingSha256, remove raw field/literal from C34L owners except explicit forbidden tests, and rerun all affected dual-host suites and independent privacy audit.

entries.mistake: The pre-state-hash negative was correctly rejected by the newer exact proof-binding invariant, but its oracle expected the old standalone preimage class.
entries.rootCause: Validation order and specificity changed without aligning this one exact fixture oracle.
entries.prevention: Align only this negative to proof-binding, retain separate history/preimage negatives, and rerun PS7 before WinPS.

entries.mistake: An attempt fixture mutated only detailed lifecycle history, so exact detailed/aggregate equality rejected before the older attempt oracle.
entries.rootCause: The fixture no longer isolated attempt semantics after parity-first validation was added.
entries.prevention: Classify the asymmetric fixture as history-equality and add a symmetric wrong-attempt proof negative that reaches attempt validation after parity.

entries.mistake: The older-unreconciled-nonterminal journal negative changed canonical preparedUtc wire spelling and was rejected before the intended chain class.
entries.rootCause: The fixture mutation or reserialization did not preserve exact UTC wire tokens while isolating the nonterminal invariant.
entries.prevention: Use raw cardinality-preserving substitution or exact canonical UTC serialization, retain a separate UTC negative, and review all remaining journal negatives before retry.

entries.mistake: The deliberate noncanonical preparedUtc fixture reached raw-wire rejection on PS7 but exact-timestamp rejection on WinPS, invalidating a single-class oracle.
entries.rootCause: Cross-host JSON date coercion changes which adjacent UTC invariant observes the malformed wire first.
entries.prevention: Use a host-stable isolating fixture where possible; otherwise assert the exact host-major-specific fail-closed class plus raw cardinality and no-write invariants.

entries.mistake: The agent inspected UTC helper source after an unexpected failure and before the failure was durably registered.
entries.rootCause: A bounded read-only diagnostic was incorrectly treated as permitted during the mandatory stop boundary.
entries.prevention: After the first unexpected failure perform no inspection, retry, or mutation until durable registration and refreshed memory gate are confirmed.

entries.mistake: A scoped status/hash command piped directly from a statement-level foreach and failed before collecting evidence.
entries.rootCause: The known unsupported foreach-to-pipeline construction was reused.
entries.prevention: Assign loop results before piping or emit one owner identity per command.

entries.mistake: A double-quoted nested pwsh parser command expanded variables in the outer host and the inner parser received malformed foreach syntax.
entries.rootCause: An interpolating nested parser wrapper was reused.
entries.prevention: Use current-host Parser.ParseFile per owner or stable direct -File checkers; never nest parser variables in double-quoted command text.

entries.mistake: The agent guessed nonexistent docs/quality/IMPLEMENTATION-MEMORY.md while locating the qualified memory gate.
entries.rootCause: The exact durable memory owner and command were replaced with an inferred filename.
entries.prevention: Use CODEX-DEVELOPMENT-REGRESSION-MEMORY.md and the exact check-codex-development-regression-memory.ps1 command; never guess a memory path.

entries.mistake: The strengthened retained candidate validator required packageName from a candidate object whose authoritative aggregate schema is intentionally minimal.
entries.rootCause: Detailed and aggregate candidate schemas were treated as identical instead of asymmetric with an exact shared projection.
entries.prevention: Validate detailed and aggregate candidates separately, require package/device identity only from detailed state and final evidence, and add a missing-detailed-package negative.

entries.mistake: An ambiguous candidate-block patch added detailed-only identity fields to aggregate fixture and left detailed fixture unchanged.
entries.rootCause: The patch hunk omitted the owning aggregate/state assignment from its anchor.
entries.prevention: Use separate bounded hunks anchored by exact aggregate/state assignments and assert aggregate minimal plus detailed package/device schemas before parsing.

entries.mistake: The replayed-attestation fixture changed evidence bytes without updating newest proof ownership, so proof binding rejected before replay semantics.
entries.rootCause: The negative changed both evidence provenance and proof-owner binding instead of isolating replay.
entries.prevention: Bind the replayed evidence path/SHA identically in detailed and aggregate newest proofs, preserve every other field, and retain stale proof binding as a separate negative.

entries.mistake: A wrong-digest fixture reserialized JSON and changed canonical producedUtc wire spelling, masking the intended digest rejection.
entries.rootCause: PowerShell JSON date coercion was introduced while mutating an unrelated digest field.
entries.prevention: Use cardinality-checked raw digest token substitution, preserve UTC and all unrelated bytes, and remove the same reserialization pattern from remaining negatives before retry.

entries.mistake: The confined real-recovery fixture enumerated an assumed evidence/transactions directory that did not exist.
entries.rootCause: The fixture path assumption was not bound to the authoritative transition/recovery journal derivation or the setup omitted the required prepared transaction.
entries.prevention: Read exact path derivation, assert existence before enumeration, and create journal state only through the real confined transition/recovery workflow.

entries.mistake: A broad social/auth/provider file inventory produced a truncated 513-line result and is not complete evidence.
entries.rootCause: Many provider terms were combined across all docs/config instead of bounded exact ticket families.
entries.prevention: Use independent exact prefix/fixed-string inventories for known auth ticket families and bound each projection.

entries.mistake: The primary guessed a C33H phone-auth ticket filename from a quality-document title and the path did not exist.
entries.rootCause: The exact config owner was not discovered before reading.
entries.prevention: Discover bounded exact C33H/firebase-phone-auth config paths first and read only returned owners independently.

entries.mistake: The primary projected guessed MVP scope-state property names and received blank values from the live differently nested schema.
entries.rootCause: The state schema was inferred before enumerating exact properties.
entries.prevention: Enumerate live property names first and project only exact selected-ticket/assessment/authority fields; never accept blank guesses as evidence.

entries.mistake: A full depth-8 projection of current and historical MVP scope state expanded and truncated instead of yielding bounded current scalars.
entries.rootCause: The full historical preselection object was serialized when only current ticket/authorization/execution fields were needed.
entries.prevention: Project current ticket id/classification/exclusions and authorization/execution scalars independently; never serialize full historical preselection state.

entries.mistake: The combined OPPO prohibited-ADB negative rejected outside its legacy exact oracle after final FIX2 validation changes.
entries.rootCause: The combined fixture oracle was not reconciled with final OPPO/retained validation order before execution.
entries.prevention: Capture sanitized actual class after registration, isolate the prohibited-action invariant, retain zero-device-action assertions, and review remaining combined oracles before retry.

entries.mistake: The combined forbidden credential-shaped-field negative rejected outside its legacy retained-evidence exact oracle.
entries.rootCause: The fixture did not isolate privacy from the new exact-schema validation order.
entries.prevention: Capture sanitized actual class, isolate a schema-valid privacy-value mutation or classify exact earlier schema rejection, and retain separate schema/privacy negatives.

entries.mistake: An unfiltered primary-agent inventory returned verbose completed-agent payloads and exceeded the available model context, so the monitoring output was truncated.
entries.rootCause: The primary requested a complete collaboration inventory after a long multi-agent run instead of a bounded path-scoped inventory or direct known-agent status.
entries.prevention: Use the narrowest path filter when agent inventory is necessary, prefer bounded waits or direct known-agent messages, and never accept truncated collaboration output as complete monitoring evidence.

entries.mistake: The independent final auditor supplied raw PowerShell as the JavaScript input to the orchestration wrapper, which failed before launching the shell.
entries.rootCause: The command crossed the JavaScript-to-shell tool boundary without placing the PowerShell text inside tools.exec_command cmd.
entries.prevention: Keep orchestration source valid JavaScript, pass PowerShell only as the exec_command cmd literal, and use bounded fixed-string reads with one authoritative operation per shell call.

entries.mistake: The readiness final-pin agent piped directly from a statement-level PowerShell foreach block into Format-Table, causing a parser failure before the command body executed.
entries.rootCause: The identity projection repeated the registered foreach-pipe construction instead of materializing loop output or reading one owner at a time.
entries.prevention: Never pipe directly from statement-level foreach; assign results before serialization, and prefer one exact owner hash/byte/line command without table formatting.

entries.mistake: A combined numbered projection of three dense transition-owner ranges exited zero but truncated inside the middle range.
entries.rootCause: The audit combined 813-1018, 1562-1933, and 2490-2763 in one output whose size exceeded the result budget.
entries.prevention: Read dense release owners in independent nonoverlapping pages of at most 100 lines, accept only warning-free output, and stop on truncation regardless of exit code.

entries.mistake: After the transition read had truncated, the auditor issued one later oversized retained-evidence multirange read, which also truncated.
entries.rootCause: The auditor did not stop immediately after the first incomplete result and repeated the dense multirange projection pattern.
entries.prevention: Stop on the first truncation before any later read, register and replay memory, then use independent nonoverlapping pages of at most 100 lines.

entries.mistake: The final auditor guessed a nonexistent REG2901 filename instead of using or discovering the literal registered owner path.
entries.rootCause: A conventional filename was derived from the incident summary rather than copied verbatim or resolved by numeric-ID discovery.
entries.prevention: Copy exact regression paths verbatim; when absent, discover the numeric ID with bounded rg --files before reading, and never derive a filename from topic text.

entries.mistake: The readiness owner began final self-tests against registry generation 2873 while a concurrent audit incident registration advanced the authoritative registry to 2874.
entries.rootCause: Independent audit registration was not frozen during the final readiness registry pin and dual-host qualification window.
entries.prevention: Freeze audit continuation during the final pin, provide one stable current registry generation, repin and run PS7 then WinPS directly, and reject any later registry movement.

entries.mistake: A three-pattern repository identifier inventory emitted the first 100-row section and only the second header, leaving the rest semantically absent without an explicit warning.
entries.rootCause: Multiple high-cardinality searches and projections were combined so the first section consumed the bounded result budget.
entries.prevention: Run each identifier search independently, return scalar counts first, page only relevant owner matches, and require expected terminal markers before accepting compound output.

entries.mistake: A repository-wide fixed-string search could yield, but the wrapper emitted only output text and discarded possible session, exit, and elapsed metadata.
entries.rootCause: The primary assumed the search would complete inside the initial yield and did not preserve the full exec_command result.
entries.prevention: Preserve the full result for any command that may yield, scope searches to relevant owners, and poll or terminate only the exact returned session before retry.

entries.mistake: The queued authentication-ticket planner combined four dense noncontiguous regression-memory windows and received an explicit truncation warning.
entries.rootCause: The planner grouped ranges 1-420, 1780-1860, 1900-1935, and 2250-2305 instead of reading isolated bounded pages.
entries.prevention: Read regression memory in independent nonoverlapping pages of at most 100 lines, verify coverage, and accept only warning-free output before planning or mutation.

entries.mistake: The primary projected inactive selection fields from a guessed nested selection object and received null instead of verified false values.
entries.rootCause: The new ticket top-level schema was inferred instead of inspecting literal property names before projection.
entries.prevention: Inspect top-level JSON property names first, use only discovered literal paths, and reject null projections when false was expected.

entries.mistake: After enumerating the live scope ticket, authorization and execution property names, the agent still projected six absent conventional selection/authorization properties and received inadmissible nulls.
entries.rootCause: A convenience projection reused familiar property names even though the immediately preceding live schema inventory proved those names were absent at the queried levels.
entries.prevention: Build projections only from literal discovered property names, treat absent properties as schema questions rather than false values, and replay the implementation memory gate before further selection or mutation.

entries.mistake: The source-map agent placed scripts config docs in the rg pattern position and produced a meaningless 411-file semantic overmatch for each Play term.
entries.rootCause: Search roots and fixed search patterns were supplied in the wrong rg argument positions.
entries.prevention: Use rg --fixed-strings -- pattern roots ordering, search one exact identifier at a time, and return scalar file counts before bounded line projections.

entries.mistake: Capture contract v2 and the Play, OPPO and journey final writers allowed caller-authored success switches, counts, producer/session/nonce identities and artifacts to form a hash-consistent but unobserved success graph.
entries.rootCause: FIX2 strengthened artifact identity without assigning observation, session creation, source binding, artifact/manifest creation and final receipt creation to one production owner.
entries.prevention: Require one authoritative production producer receipt bound to its script hash, sealed source, exact state/aggregate/artifact/vector, qualified source-owner receipts, session and journal; production final writers accept no caller success claims and missing adapters fail closed.

entries.mistake: The FIX3 journey-adapter owner piped directly from a statement-level PowerShell foreach block into Format-Table while collecting file metadata, causing a parser failure before the command body executed.
entries.rootCause: The metadata projection repeated the registered statement-level foreach-pipeline construction instead of materializing loop output or reading each owner independently.
entries.prevention: Never pipe directly from a statement-level foreach; assign the loop results before formatting, prefer scalar per-owner metadata reads, and stop on the first parser failure until this registration and memory replay complete.

entries.mistake: Two concurrent FIX3 streams independently allocated numeric REG2910 to different full string IDs, and the existing memory gate did not reject the duplicate numeric prefix.
entries.rootCause: Subagents appended registry entries without primary-coordinated numeric reservation, while validation enforced full IDs but not unique numeric prefixes.
entries.prevention: Only the primary allocates future REG numbers; subagents report and wait for literal IDs, and a future registry gate must reject duplicate numeric prefixes.

entries.mistake: The primary combined durable documents with a registry correction whose assumed evidence-array line context did not match the live formatted entry, so the patch was atomically rejected.
entries.rootCause: A remembered single-line registry context was used instead of reading the exact live P0 object and applying separate bounded patches.
entries.prevention: Read the exact live object, add docs separately, correct the unique ID/path in a minimal hunk, then append incident entries with exact tail context.

entries.mistake: The journey adapter passed its checker-owned fixture run directory through a resolver that requires PathType Leaf, so the positive fixture rejected before intended validation.
entries.rootCause: A leaf-file resolver was reused for both immutable receipt files and an exact fixture root directory.
entries.prevention: Use a dedicated container resolver or explicit path-kind validation, canonicalize the exact run root first, confine children, and add dual-host file-vs-directory/reparse negatives.

entries.mistake: A multi-file v3 contract propagation patch relied on an expected OPPO checker constant layout that did not match the live owner, so patch verification rejected the operation.
entries.rootCause: Several heterogeneous existing owners were grouped into one patch using remembered context instead of independently reread exact anchors.
entries.prevention: Inventory literal declarations per owner, patch one owner per bounded operation, parse/read back before advancing, and prohibit broad propagation patches under the coordination policy.

entries.mistake: The repository lacked a machine-enforced primary-only regression allocator, exclusive active owner claims, duplicate numeric-prefix rejection and mandatory pre-action coordination gate for every subagent.
entries.rootCause: Durable mistake registration existed, but cross-agent allocation, owner, generation, session and real-action serialization were procedural rather than one mandatory machine policy.
entries.prevention: Require AGENTS policy reading, machine-recorded owner claims, primary-only registry/action authority, unique numeric IDs, stable generation, prevention-class inventory and the coordination gate before every subagent action.

entries.mistake: The primary emitted the complete personal Codex config before measuring or limiting the read, and the tool output was truncated.
entries.rootCause: A potentially large personal configuration owner was treated as a small text file instead of projecting only the three exact requested top-level keys.
entries.prevention: Measure first, inspect only exact top-level requested keys before the first section, never print unrelated values, minimally patch, and validate TOML plus the three effective values.

entries.mistake: A resumed FIX3 subagent raw-read the complete 9,878-line active handoff and received an explicitly truncated projection.
entries.rootCause: The current bounded checkpoint requirement was converted into a full append-only owner read instead of heading discovery plus small independent pages.
entries.prevention: Discover the current checkpoint, read only independent <=100-line pages, reject explicit or semantic truncation, and perform no owner action until reconstruction and the refreshed coordination gate pass.

entries.mistake: A resumed FIX3 subagent bundled unbounded full dirty-tree status with scalar branch and HEAD checks, and the 145,730-token status output truncated.
entries.rootCause: Known-large repository status was not confined to literal claimed owners, and authoritative scalar evidence was combined with the unbounded projection.
entries.prevention: Run branch and HEAD independently, use only bounded branch-header and literal claim-scoped status projections, and reject any truncated combined result as zero evidence.

entries.mistake: The journey FIX3 parser launcher used an outer double-quoted nested pwsh command, allowing the outer host to expand parser variables and corrupt the inner command.
entries.rootCause: A prohibited nested command-string parser wrapper was used instead of direct current-host ParseFile or a literal direct -File gate.
entries.prevention: Parse directly in the current host with local variables; use a literal direct -File owner for the second host; never interpolate nested parser command text.

entries.mistake: The first fresh PS7 authoritative journey fixture reached the positive gate row but its producedUtc representation failed the exact canonical UTC validator.
entries.rootCause: The fixture wire/runtime timestamp shape and the adapter validator did not agree; the exact coercion or grammar cause remains bounded for post-registration diagnosis.
entries.prevention: Inspect sanitized raw-token cardinality and runtime type, preserve exact .fffZ wire spelling, normalize cross-host runtime shapes semantically, add strict UTC negatives, then rerun PS7 before WinPS.

entries.mistake: The fresh PS7 journey fixture accessed Count on an unnormalized singleton result after advancing beyond UTC validation.
entries.rootCause: A zero/one/many PowerShell pipeline boundary was assumed to remain an array under StrictMode.
entries.prevention: Normalize every collection boundary with array subexpression before Count/index access and cover zero, singleton and multiple shapes on both PowerShell hosts.

entries.mistake: The first WinPS journey fixture rejected the offset negative outside the checker's expected sanitized class after the equivalent PS7 suite passed.
entries.rootCause: The intentionally noncanonical timestamp exercised a host-dependent validation or serialization order not represented by the fixture oracle.
entries.prevention: Inspect only the sanitized WinPS class, prefer host-invariant raw-wire cardinality defects, or enumerate only intrinsically correct exact host classes while preserving the semantic rejection invariant.

entries.mistake: The WinPS journey fixture advanced past the redesigned raw-wire offset negative but the remaining non-.fff precision negative rejected outside its expected class.
entries.rootCause: The precision fixture used a decoded value whose host-specific grammar validation could mask the intended raw-token validation.
entries.prevention: Use a canonical decoded .fffZ value with only a raw-wire precision/cardinality defect, audit remaining timestamp negatives for masking, and require one exact class on both hosts.

entries.mistake: The journey FIX3 checker passed both hosts but left 64 exact-prefix directories and 3 file-as-root negative fixtures instead of proving deterministic cleanup.
entries.rootCause: Fixture creation was not governed by one outer try/finally path inventory with path-kind-aware unlink/delete and absence assertions.
entries.prevention: Track every exact created path, prove legacy residue ownership/confinement/privacy, remove only verified checker roots, assert absence, and require cleanupVerified=true with zero new residue on both hosts.

entries.mistake: The authoritative capture producer privacy walker rejected the required exact passwordlessEmailSend action-count property before a positive fixture result.
entries.rootCause: Generic forbidden-name substring scanning was applied to exact allowlisted schema keys without a position-specific canonical action-count exemption.
entries.prevention: Validate exact schemas first, exempt only exact canonical action-count keys at approved positions, retain unknown/private negatives, inventory any residue, and rerun PS7 before WinPS.

entries.mistake: The authoritative PS7 fixture reached source-attestation validation but a grouped identity/type/producer/session/nonce/preimage/artifact assertion masked the exact mismatched field.
entries.rootCause: Producer-consumer contract fields were compared in one aggregate assertion instead of deterministic per-field sanitized checks.
entries.prevention: Diagnose and validate each non-private binding field independently, name only the mismatched field/class, correct only proven drift, retain per-field negatives, inventory residue, then rerun PS7 before WinPS.

entries.mistake: The authoritative PS7 source-attestation fixture isolated a sessionId contract mismatch between producer output and consumer validation.
entries.rootCause: Producer and consumer did not yet share one deterministic session derivation/grammar bound to the approved nonce and transition challenge.
entries.prevention: Define and enforce one derived session ID across receipt, manifest, attestation and journal; reject caller-authored sessions; add wrong-session/nonce/challenge/stale/replay negatives; then rerun PS7 before WinPS.

entries.mistake: The authoritative PS7 fixture advanced through Play and OPPO but the first journey artifact path lacked its required publicGuest ancestor before persistence.
entries.rootCause: The journey adapter/scaffolding and capture producer did not yet have one explicit owner for creation of canonical per-row output ancestors.
entries.prevention: Assign canonical output-directory creation to the producer after validation, keep adapter sources confined, prove every ancestor, reject reparse/sibling/cross-row aliases, add path negatives, then rerun PS7 before WinPS.

entries.mistake: The authoritative capture producer reused an existing-input resolver for a canonical output root whose producer-owned immediate parent does not yet exist.
