entries.prevention: Read exact current ranges and apply independently bounded hunks with readback after each section.

entries.mistake: Bootstrap source patches resumed after registry movement to generation 3057 without first replaying the updated mandatory gates.
entries.rootCause: Continuation of one defect repair was treated as retaining the prior registry-bound execution pin.
entries.prevention: Treat every registry movement as invalidating the pin and replay regression, coordination and MVP gates before the next mutation or test.

entries.mistake: The bootstrap rendered visible text but its required semantic label was merged away by nested brand semantics.
entries.rootCause: The Semantics wrapper was not an explicit container with explicit child nodes.
entries.prevention: Use an explicit semantic container and retain visible-text plus semantic-label widget coverage.

entries.mistake: The checksum-matched r60.79 candidate rendered the same update-required customer frame as r60.77 while source and widget gates had passed.
entries.rootCause: The machine contract allowed build qualification without a real installed cold-start receipt, and runtime recovery emitted no sanitized failing-stage identifier.
entries.prevention: Block successor builds until transition timing identifies the stage; add sanitized stage receipts and require passed installed cold-start evidence before auth promotion.

entries.mistake: The cold-start qualification receipt was claimed but missing when the generation-3060 coordination gate ran.
entries.rootCause: Evidence capture and receipt creation were split across a gate boundary requiring all owners to exist.
entries.prevention: Create the bounded receipt immediately after its captures and before the next coordination replay.

entries.mistake: Planned one-second and six-second timing screenshot owners were claimed before capture, so coordination rejected the diagnostic.
entries.rootCause: Future generated evidence was treated like an existing repository owner.
entries.prevention: Capture to validated temporary paths first, then register and move only completed evidence.

entries.mistake: r60.80 passed source gates but its dex contained neither GeneratedPluginRegistrant nor the Firebase Core plugin, and firebase_initialize failed on device.
entries.rootCause: The AGP source-set repair excluded the entire Java root, removing production plugin registration and allowing release shrinking to drop plugin classes.
entries.prevention: Restore and unignore a durable registrant with only integration_test removed; require registrant and Firebase Core in source and dex before install.

entries.mistake: Platform and C30W source-order checks inferred runtime order from the failure runApp helper definition after the bootstrap refactor.
entries.rootCause: The gates searched for a literal implementation statement instead of the precheck helper call and bootstrap call sites.
entries.prevention: Assert precheck helper and bootstrap call sites precede Firebase; separately assert the helper owns failure rendering.

entries.mistake: Flutter test regenerated the ignored plugin registrant and reintroduced IntegrationTestPlugin after a manual source edit.
entries.rootCause: A generated lifecycle owner was treated as durable source instead of applying a release-variant transformation.
entries.prevention: Keep the registrant ignored, sanitize only the release variant before Java compilation, retain Firebase Core, and verify final dex contents.

entries.mistake: The comprehensive mobile suite ended with 1617 passes, 36 skips and 247 visual golden failures across multiple surfaces.
entries.rootCause: Pending representative bounded diagnostics; the aggregate may share one rendering or baseline infrastructure cause.
entries.prevention: Classify a representative failure before source or baseline changes; never auto-regenerate goldens and retain aggregate totals in pre-APK evidence.

entries.mistake: The backend verify command exited zero but the bounded TAP parser captured no test/pass/fail counts.
entries.rootCause: The parser assumed hash-prefixed summary lines not used by the active Node reporter.
entries.prevention: Capture one bounded raw reporter tail, identify exact syntax, then parse counts before accepting evidence.

entries.mistake: Android release Java compiled with correct plugin filtering, but lintRelease failed with 6 errors and 2 warnings; first error was missing FacebookActivity.
entries.rootCause: Complete classification pending; native Facebook release dependency or manifest composition is incomplete.
entries.prevention: Make lintRelease a mandatory pre-APK gate, fix every item without a baseline, and require zero errors before build authorization.

entries.mistake: The new Android data-extraction owner claim used a nonexistent adjacent styles owner and the patch was rejected.
entries.rootCause: Policy context was inferred instead of read from the exact Android owner range.
entries.prevention: Insert new Android owners beside a verified live manifest/build owner after bounded raw readback.

entries.mistake: Android lint source fixes resumed after registry movement to generation 3069 without first replaying mandatory gates.
entries.rootCause: The registry-binding update was not treated as immediately invalidating the prior execution pin.
entries.prevention: Make mandatory gate replay the next action after every registry binding update; forbid source patches until it passes.

entries.mistake: The YouTube return isolation test forbade every moolsocial scheme in MainActivity, conflicting with legitimate X and Instagram callback owners.
entries.rootCause: Provider isolation was expressed as a global scheme prohibition instead of an exact YouTube host/path prohibition.
entries.prevention: Forbid only the YouTube authority/path in MainActivity and require it exactly in the dedicated return activity.

entries.mistake: The backend success return-page test retained raw triple-slash URL segment parsing after the canonical authority change and failed 1 of 579 tests.
entries.rootCause: The test indexed URL text instead of parsing and asserting scheme, authority, path and query contract.
entries.prevention: Use URL parsing and exact component assertions for both success and failure return links.

entries.mistake: Cursor reported a B2 manifest read whose output truncated before a complete bounded terminal result.
entries.rootCause: Manifest entries or filenames were emitted instead of an in-memory bounded aggregate.
entries.prevention: Compute count/bytes/SHA in memory, capture stdout/stderr separately, and emit only aggregate fields plus exit code.

entries.mistake: Android audit assertions and a source-order oracle update changed the checksum-bound platform_configuration_test.dart owner.
entries.rootCause: A locked Screen 03 production test was treated as an available audit successor owner.
entries.prevention: Restore it byte-for-byte, satisfy its original source contract, and create a separately claimed audit test for new assertions.

entries.mistake: Flutter/Gradle regenerated ignored local.properties without lint escaping, so the successor audit's transient-file assertion failed.
entries.rootCause: Generated local configuration was treated as durable source rather than a task-scoped lint input.
entries.prevention: Normalize local.properties immediately before lintRelease and test the Gradle task contract instead of transient contents.

entries.mistake: The refreshed Cursor worktree coordination gate stopped because its parent-derived ../AGENTS.md workspace instruction did not exist.
entries.rootCause: The checker assumes the repository's immediate parent is the workspace root, which is false for the approved nested MOOLSOCIAL-WORKTREES layout.
entries.prevention: Mirror the authoritative workspace AGENTS.md at the exact worktree-parent path with byte/hash equality and qualify parent instruction resolution before dispatching future isolated worktrees.

entries.mistake: The refreshed Cursor worktree regression-memory gate stopped on a missing historical registered evidence owner.
entries.rootCause: The primary refresh accepted a pre-copy projection without requiring the target worktree's complete registry-evidence resolver to report zero missing owners.
entries.prevention: Reconcile every current registry evidence owner sequentially with source/target length and SHA-256 equality, require zero missing paths, and only then replay isolated memory and coordination gates.

entries.mistake: The copied global active-claim set required an uncommitted Desktop source owner inside the intentionally isolated Cursor baseline worktree.
entries.rootCause: The global coordination policy validates every active claim against one repository root and is not directly portable to an isolated worktree that intentionally excludes Desktop source changes.
entries.prevention: Use a primary-created worktree-scoped policy projection retaining the current registry binding and Cursor's exact report owner while excluding unrelated Desktop/source claims only in the isolated worktree.

entries.mistake: The release lint task streamed a large Gradle task graph that truncated before a later terminal poll returned build success and exit zero.
entries.rootCause: Gradle stdout/stderr were not captured separately and reduced to a bounded lint summary.
entries.prevention: Replay lint through in-memory process capture and emit only exit, success, task, report, error and warning counts plus report length and SHA-256.

entries.mistake: Cursor's read-only audit stopped because the exact recorded FIX7 ticket was absent from its isolated worktree.
entries.rootCause: The refresh reconciled registry evidence closure but not every literal mandatory-read owner required by the assigned audit scope.
entries.prevention: Materialize the exact FIX7 ticket with byte/hash equality, refresh the binding, and provide this literal incident path plus explicit retry authority before Cursor resumes.

entries.mistake: A FIX7 status-page search included a guessed nonexistent positional hosting root and returned a ripgrep path error.
entries.rootCause: The current Hosting owner was inferred from convention instead of resolved from firebase.json or a bounded file inventory.
entries.prevention: Resolve exact current Hosting roots first, search only literal existing paths, and isolate expected-absence queries with explicit no-match handling.

entries.mistake: The public deletion page promises seven-day completion while the approved FIX7 policy permits up to thirty days.
entries.rootCause: The public page predates the founder-approved durable erasure policy and is not bound to its machine-readable SLA.
entries.prevention: Correct the page to thirty days, add confirmation-scoped pending/completed/failed status behavior, and bind source tests to the FIX7 ticket value before Meta review.

entries.mistake: Cursor repeated the REG3107 local coordination rejection because the isolated worktree still carried Desktop's global active claims.
entries.rootCause: The worktree-scoped policy projection required by REG3107 was not implemented before Cursor replayed its local gate.
entries.prevention: Stop Cursor for this phase; the Desktop primary retains the audit until a separately designed and self-tested scoped worktree policy and branch-safe gate are authorized.

entries.mistake: A Data Connect adapter lookup projected InputStream instead of repository paths after piping an in-memory filename array through Select-String.
entries.rootCause: Select-String pipeline input does not retain each input filename as its Path owner.
entries.prevention: Use Select-String -LiteralPath per resolved file or bounded rg against literal roots whenever matched source paths are required.

entries.mistake: A multi-hunk FIX7 primary-owner claim patch was rejected because one remembered FIX6 script context was stale.
entries.rootCause: Distant source, script and evidence claim insertions were coupled without rereading every exact current neighbor.
entries.prevention: Patch claim groups against independently verified local policy context, parse after each accepted owner update and never treat an atomic rejection as partial authority.

entries.mistake: The primary claimed backend/functions/src/index.ts for FIX7 while an inactive auth broker claim still held the same owner.
entries.rootCause: The current owner-to-task map was not projected before adding the shared runtime owner.
entries.prevention: Project shared-owner claimants first, explicitly release the inactive claimant, require one canonical owner and replay coordination before mutation.

entries.mistake: The first FIX7 strict typecheck reported two TS2379 errors where the in-memory test store explicitly assigned undefined to exact-optional fields.
entries.rootCause: The test fake cleared optional fields by assigning undefined instead of structurally omitting them.
entries.prevention: Destructure stale optional fields from replacement records, then rerun strict typecheck before compiled tests.

entries.mistake: A subagent projected nonexistent coordination-policy property activeTasks and received a null claim instead of using activeClaims.
entries.rootCause: The human phrase active tasks was converted into a guessed JSON property despite the exact root-property inventory.
entries.prevention: Filter policy.activeClaims by canonical task, require one result and one owner, then run gates with the refreshed binding.

entries.mistake: A subagent projected registry entries through nonexistent $j.registry.entries and received a null-coerced count of one at generation 3088.
entries.rootCause: A wrapper object was invented instead of selecting the registry's exact root entries property.
entries.prevention: Use $j.entries, require the authoritative exact count before tail access, and keep the new parallel audit tasks stopped for this phase.

entries.mistake: The first integrated FIX7 typecheck found one union-narrowing test error, one duplicate index options property and missing Facebook eraser wiring.
entries.rootCause: A short insertion matched the earlier Instagram options boundary, and the test did not retain its narrowed deletion result in a definite local.
entries.prevention: Patch inside exact named factory functions, read complete option objects, capture narrowed results in definite locals and rerun typecheck before compiled tests.

entries.mistake: An inline Node copy-digest command was rejected by PowerShell before execution because JavaScript regex brackets crossed the shell boundary.
entries.rootCause: Shell-sensitive JavaScript was embedded in a PowerShell native argument instead of using a repository-owned test/helper.
entries.prevention: Do not retry inline quoting; obtain the current digest through the owned web test boundary and patch only its exact literal.

entries.mistake: The first bounded FIX7 Firestore emulator wrapper returned exit one with no test summary while suppressing its small diagnostic output.
entries.rootCause: The wrapper omitted a bounded diagnostic field, leaving command syntax/startup versus product-test failure unclassified.
entries.prevention: Expose the already bounded diagnostic once after registration, classify the failure, then rerun only a corrected bounded emulator command.

entries.mistake: Firebase Emulator Suite stopped before startup because the child could not spawn java -version.
entries.rootCause: The command did not expose the Flutter-configured bundled JDK to the emulator child despite global Java being absent.
entries.prevention: Resolve and verify the bundled JDK, set JAVA_HOME/PATH only for the child, restore the parent environment and never install or globally mutate Java.

entries.mistake: Data Connect emulators:exec returned script success and exit zero while its Postgres emulator reported ECONNRESET and shutdown failure.
entries.rootCause: The wrapper admitted script and process exit without requiring zero emulator-owned error lines.
entries.prevention: Require zero emulator error lines and use a direct no-apply schema validation path instead of repeating the unstable emulator run.

entries.mistake: The no-apply Data Connect SQL-diff read returned exit one with one error line and no SQL output.
entries.rootCause: The local CLI/read context could not complete the direct validation surface after the emulator path was rejected.
entries.prevention: Do not retry or bypass credentials; retain validation as pending until a later founder-controlled authenticated schema-validation window.

entries.mistake: A read-only mobile test-inventory wrapper used an invalid JavaScript field token and was rejected before shell execution.
entries.rootCause: A shell-style prefix was applied to the declared workdir property name.
entries.prevention: Use the exact tool-call schema and invoke already-known literal focused auth/startup test owners without another discovery wrapper.

entries.mistake: The new APK integrity gate resolved one apkanalyzer path then accessed Count after PowerShell unwrapped it to a string.
entries.rootCause: The pipeline selection result was not explicitly normalized to an array before cardinality validation.
entries.prevention: Wrap selected tool paths in @(...), require one, copy the scalar path and qualify immutable negative plus positive APK fixtures before build use.

entries.mistake: The first authorized non-interactive FIX7 Dev Data Connect service readback returned exit one and the bounded classifier identified authentication failure.
entries.rootCause: The saved local Firebase CLI session could not authorize the required Data Connect metadata read.
entries.prevention: Do not retry or source alternate credentials; require founder-controlled Firebase reauthentication, then replay regression, coordination and MVP gates before one new read-only Dev preflight.

entries.mistake: The post-reauthentication Data Connect service-list readback returned exit one while the bounded wrapper exposed only the coarse class other.
entries.rootCause: The wrapper classified every HTTP 403 as permission denial before checking the provider's structured reason, while the authoritative Policy Troubleshooter later proved an IAM Allow policy permits services.list.
entries.prevention: Do not request IAM changes or infer absence from HTTP status alone; after gate replay parse only the structured error status, code and reason allowlist from one bounded read-only result.

entries.mistake: The Firebase Hosting site-list read exited zero with one result, but a remembered field projection emitted a blank site identity.
entries.rootCause: The readback assumed site, name or type fields without first enumerating the installed Firebase CLI result schema.
entries.prevention: Enumerate the one result object's property names after registration and gate replay, then project only verified fields; never infer Hosting readiness from native exit alone.

entries.mistake: The gcloud preflight exited zero but its saved default project was not exactly moolsocial-dev-503018.
entries.rootCause: The installed gcloud configuration is not bound by default to the authorized Dev project, so an unqualified command could target another context.
entries.prevention: Do not emit or mutate the unrelated default; every permitted gcloud read must carry the explicit Dev project and validate returned resource scope before an IAM decision.

entries.mistake: The explicit moolsocial-dev-503018 gcloud project identity read returned exit one and the bounded classifier identified authentication failure.
entries.rootCause: The installed gcloud credential context cannot currently authorize even the explicit-Dev project metadata read.
entries.prevention: Do not retry, obtain tokens or import credentials; require founder-controlled gcloud authentication, retain explicit Dev scoping and replay all three gates before one new read-only preflight.

entries.mistake: IAM Policy Troubleshooter returned exit one with an authentication classification while explicit-Dev project and IAM policy reads succeeded.
entries.rootCause: The gcloud project surface lacks a usable credential or quota context for Policy Troubleshooter, so it cannot establish the active principal's effective Data Connect permission.
entries.prevention: Do not retry or use token and alternate-credential surfaces; ask the founder immediately for an authoritative read-only effective-permission result before another gated Data Connect attempt.

entries.mistake: Codex asked the founder to add Data Connect and Cloud SQL roles before checking the Console evidence that the intended Dev administrator already has Owner.
entries.rootCause: A direct-member projection neither resolved inherited access nor proved that gcloud and Firebase were using the same principal, but Codex converted it into role-change guidance.
entries.prevention: Never request an IAM grant from a direct-binding projection alone; account for inherited Owner/Admin access and ask only for a read-only effective-permission result when truth remains unclear.

entries.mistake: A read-only registry locator matched the REG3128 identifier in both the id and evidence path, then used the line-number array as a scalar.
entries.rootCause: The locator did not bind the identifier to the exact quoted JSON id property or require exactly one match before range arithmetic.
entries.prevention: Use an exact quoted id-property match, normalize with @(...), require one scalar line number and only then read a bounded range.

entries.mistake: The exact Data Connect compile for moolsocial-core in asia-south1 returned exit one with JSON status error and an authentication classification.
entries.rootCause: The Firebase Data Connect compile surface could not complete while the Dev console remained unprovisioned, and its small error was not yet classified beyond the safe authentication category.
entries.prevention: Do not retry or create blindly; ask the founder immediately to expose only the next Get started choices, inspect them and retain zero cloud mutations until the creation path is qualified.

entries.mistake: A read-only APK-state projection placed statement-form if directly after string concatenation and was rejected before projecting runtime defines.
entries.rootCause: The command repeated the known rule that statement forms cannot serve as inline PowerShell value expressions.
entries.prevention: Compute each optional display value into a named scalar before concatenation; never put statement-form if directly after plus or in a property value.

entries.mistake: The public-auth sideload composition selects a cancellation-only ReviewSocialAuthGateway and therefore cannot execute real provider login or X/Instagram callback completion.
entries.rootCause: MOOLSOCIAL_DEVICE_REVIEW was treated as permission to replace the gateway even when the separately qualified sideload profile requires live Dev authentication.
entries.prevention: Use one explicit live global-social-login audit mode that reuses FirebaseSocialAuthGateway and prove main-composition plus cold and foreground callback behavior before any successor build.

entries.mistake: The public-auth sideload profile requests limited-use App Check tokens but startup activates Play Integrity only for the unrelated YouTube private-proof flag.
entries.rootCause: App Check activation was scoped by feature name instead of the exact runtime operations that require attested tokens.
entries.prevention: Activate the Dev Play Integrity provider for the explicit live global-social-login audit mode before gateway construction and retain wrong-project, emulator and missing-mode negative tests.

entries.mistake: Device-review composition passes null provider availability and forces review OTP availability, exposing methods that production qualification holds, including Apple and unattested Mobile OTP.
entries.rootCause: Review-mode convenience overrode the production PublicAuthRuntimeConfiguration truth at the main composition boundary.
entries.prevention: The live global-social-login audit mode consumes the production provider set and real method qualification; held methods remain unavailable in source, semantics and behavior tests.

entries.mistake: Post-login completion is either a no-op review bootstrap or the founder-held DataConnectAccountBootstrapGateway, so no current mode proves a retained real Firebase session without provisional business schema.
entries.rootCause: Authentication-session verification and future application database bootstrap were coupled behind one interface with no shared global Firebase-only production adapter.
entries.prevention: Add a shared Firebase-authenticated-session verifier for the exact audit mode, create no business-domain data, and prove success, missing user, timeout, rollback, relaunch and sign-out before candidate selection.

entries.mistake: The first FIX8 MVP-selection patch combined a current-ticket scalar and long selected-assessment replacement whose remembered context did not match the live JSON.
entries.rootCause: Rendered excerpt text was used as byte-exact patch context for a large mutable machine-state subtree.
entries.prevention: Patch the unique current-ticket scalar independently, then use freshly read small exact field and array hunks and project every accepted subtree before continuing.

entries.mistake: The FIX8 robustness-coverage array patch reused rendered strings that did not match the live selected-assessment JSON after earlier accepted state changes.
entries.rootCause: The named array was not freshly read from its immediate current local block before replacement.
entries.prevention: Read the immediate selected assessment array, patch that literal block alone and parse and count it before touching the next field.

entries.mistake: The MVP gate was replayed while the pre-ticket and selected-assessment identities were FIX8 but the active top-level ticket remained FIX5.
entries.rootCause: Registry movement occurred between incremental selection identity hunks, forcing a gate replay against an intentionally incomplete executable selection.
entries.prevention: Perform only bounded selection recovery until active ticket, assessment and manifest agree, parse every hunk and run the full gate before any runtime action.

entries.mistake: The complete FIX8 top-level ticket replacement used an underscore where the live FIX5 test-plan string contains a literal space and was rejected atomically.
entries.rootCause: A long complete-object replacement retained one manually normalized token rather than exact live JSON context.
entries.prevention: Patch top-level ticket scalars first and each freshly read named array independently, parsing and counting every accepted hunk.

entries.mistake: A freshly read complete robustness array was still retried as one whole-array replacement and rejected in the dense MVP state owner.
entries.rootCause: The replacement repeated a patch shape already proven unreliable for this large mutable JSON.
entries.prevention: Never retry a whole-array replacement here; substitute one unique current string per patch and parse the array after each accepted line.

entries.mistake: The third one-line robustness substitution retyped the current X coverage scalar with different punctuation and underscore placement and was rejected.
entries.rootCause: The smaller patch still manually transcribed a long current scalar instead of copying the parsed indexed value exactly.
entries.prevention: Project remaining array values as indexed live scalars, copy each returned scalar exactly, patch one line and verify that index immediately.

entries.mistake: The inherited FIX5 provider gate rejected the exact selected FIX8 source-repair ticket before evaluating its comprehensive-audit state.
entries.rootCause: The gate's selected-ticket allowlist predates FIX8 and recognizes only earlier FIX5 lifecycle identities.
entries.prevention: Add only an exact manifest-bound FIX8 successor branch while preserving every FIX5 provider fact, privacy prohibition and zero build, Play, OPPO and private-action count.

entries.mistake: The backend command appended the dot reporter after the positional test glob, retained verbose spec output and truncated despite a visible 586/586 summary.
entries.rootCause: Reporter option ordering through npm script forwarding did not control the compiled Node test invocation.
entries.prevention: Invoke node --test with reporter options before the verified compiled glob, capture stdout and stderr plus native exit in memory and emit only bounded explicit totals.

entries.mistake: The inherited shared public-authentication gate rejected the exact selected FIX8 ticket after analyzer, 255 affected tests and UI locks passed.
entries.rootCause: The shared gate's authorized C34P ticket set predates the FIX8 source-repair descendant.
entries.prevention: Add only the manifest-bound FIX8 branch while preserving all shared source, secret/private and release holds, then restart both full source cycles after generation replay.

entries.mistake: The inherited FIX1A all-eight gate rejected the exact selected FIX8 ticket after the shared gate passed.
entries.rootCause: The FIX1A authorized descendant set recognizes FIX5 but predates the FIX8 audit-repair descendant.
entries.prevention: Add only the exact manifest-bound FIX8 branch while preserving all FIX1A source, provider, privacy, held-action and unrelated-ticket negative assertions.

entries.mistake: The unattended safe-automation patch output was compacted, and the first bounded readback incorrectly checked a top-level property even though the object existed under comprehensiveSuccessorAudit.
entries.rootCause: The target JSON path was reconstructed at the wrong object depth after compaction.
entries.prevention: Treat compacted mutation output as unknown, but read back the exact full nested path before classifying absence; never retry when the authoritative nested readback proves the object already exists.

entries.mistake: A bounded diagnostic guessed config/regression-registry.json although the authoritative owner is config/codex-development-regression-registry.json.
entries.rootCause: The registry path was recalled generically instead of copied from the reconstructed coordination state.
entries.prevention: Use the exact authoritative registry owner path from coordination state; if it is unavailable, locate one bounded filename match before attempting to parse it.

entries.mistake: The fallback registry locator searched every regression or incident JSON and Markdown path and produced a truncated 516-line result.
entries.rootCause: The fallback expression was broader than the single config registry filename needed for recovery.
entries.prevention: Constrain recovery to config and the exact codex-development-regression-registry filename pattern, and project only the first exact match.

entries.mistake: The first unattended-state projection queried j.unattendedAutomation instead of j.comprehensiveSuccessorAudit.unattendedAutomation and reported a false absence.
entries.rootCause: The diagnostic reconstructed the expected property at top level instead of reading the live parent object first.
entries.prevention: Project the live top-level property names and the complete immediate parent object before testing a nested field; a false absence must be corrected before retry and must never trigger a duplicate write.

entries.mistake: The bounded OPPO cold-launch wrapper required cmd package resolve-activity --brief to begin with com.moolsocial.app/ and rejected the actual resolver shape before force-stop.
entries.rootCause: The wrapper assumed one Android resolver output shape without first projecting the connected device's exact bounded result.
entries.prevention: After registration, read the resolver output once, validate it contains only the expected package and activity, then use the exact validated component for one separately gated cold launch.

entries.mistake: The single authorized r60.80 cold launch returned ok and a live process, but the bounded projection found no mResumedActivity match and could not qualify foreground visible state.
entries.rootCause: The initial projection used mResumedActivity as its only receipt while the screen was non-interactive and the Android dump exposed usable ResumedActivity, top-activity and window-focus fields through different lines.
entries.prevention: Do not repeat the launch; after registration use one bounded power, window-focus and activity projection together, and never treat a screen-off receipt as customer-visible or performance qualification.

entries.mistake: A bounded YouTube source projector embedded $p followed by a colon and then $i inside one interpolated PowerShell string, causing a parser error.
entries.rootCause: The command repeated the registered colon-after-variable interpolation shape instead of using the format operator or braced variables.
entries.prevention: Use the PowerShell format operator for path, line and content projections; never place a colon immediately after an unbraced variable token.

entries.mistake: The YouTube source projector represented single line ranges as nested arrays that PowerShell flattened, causing Math.Min argument-type errors and only a partial bridge read.
entries.rootCause: PowerShell array unrolling changed the expected two-element range object shape for files with one range.
entries.prevention: Project each file with explicit integer start and end scalars, or use named range objects; set ErrorActionPreference Stop and reject any partial output.

entries.mistake: A batched web open of five public MoolSocial compliance URLs was rejected by the web safety layer as unsafe to open.
entries.rootCause: The web opener did not permit direct navigation to the project domain in that tool context.
entries.prevention: Do not retry the rejected web-open route; after registration use one bounded non-authenticated public HTTP status/title readback and keep every external write or login prohibited.

entries.mistake: The unauthenticated live delete-account page returned 200, but an overly narrow matcher requiring 30 immediately followed by days reported a false absence and initially inferred stale Hosting.
entries.rootCause: The matcher did not allow an intervening word such as calendar and was not first proven against the current local source.
entries.prevention: Prove compliance-wording matchers against current source before applying them live; allow bounded intervening text, compare source and public booleans, and never infer a deployment need from an unproven matcher.

entries.mistake: The public/source compliance check used 30 followed directly by days and returned false for both, despite the qualified source using a founder-approved 30-day maximum with possible intervening wording.
entries.rootCause: The content matcher was not self-tested against the current source before its live result was classified.
entries.prevention: First prove one bounded flexible matcher against current source, then apply the identical matcher to the live page and report only source/live booleans and HTTP status.

entries.mistake: The first REG3160 correction patch included the same REG3160 id as an extra trailing expected anchor after already matching its block, and apply_patch rejected the patch.
entries.rootCause: The correction patch retained an unnecessary duplicate context locator.
entries.prevention: Use one unique scalar replacement block and one unique evidence-line append anchor; do not repeat an already consumed id as trailing context.

entries.mistake: A source-proven bounded matcher found the founder-approved 30-day maximum in current delete-page source but not in the HTTP-200 live page.
entries.rootCause: The currently public delete-account page is behind the qualified local FIX7 privacy/delete content.
entries.prevention: Hold final YouTube submission; after founder review, deploy only the separately authorized exact Hosting scope and require public 200 plus 30-day source/live parity before any reviewer message is approved.

entries.mistake: The audited mobile YouTube connection/control surface exposes Privacy, Disconnect, Google permissions and account deletion links but no direct YouTube Terms of Service link.
entries.rootCause: Earlier compliance work proved public policy pages and connection controls but did not bind the current Developer Policies direct-link requirement into the mobile YouTube surface and its tests.
entries.prevention: Keep final submission held; after FIX8 acceptance select one exact successor ticket to add direct YouTube Terms and Google Privacy links to the mobile YouTube control surface, update focused tests, run two clean cycles and include device proof in the screencast.

entries.mistake: The final non-emitting dirty digest invoked git status with every untracked path, traversed legacy long-path browser evidence, emitted 267 warning lines and produced truncated output.
entries.rootCause: The diagnostic bypassed the repository's bounded dirty-digest method and asked Git to enumerate the huge untracked tree on Windows.
entries.prevention: Do not credit the emitted count or hash; after registration locate and use the existing bounded non-emitting dirty-digest owner, suppress path warnings and emit only status/count/hash after native exit zero.

entries.mistake: The final seal projected mvp.selectedAssessment.manifestSha256 and returned null even though the authorized FIX8 gate had passed with a bound ticket hash.
entries.rootCause: The projection guessed the selected-assessment property depth instead of reading the live MVP state property inventory.
entries.prevention: After registration project the live top-level names and immediate selected parent, then compare the exact manifest field to the independently computed FIX8 ticket hash.

entries.mistake: After correcting the selected manifest path, the final seal separately guessed mvp.currentTicket.ticketId and returned null.
entries.rootCause: The projection added an unnecessary optional field without first proving its live path, repeating the property-depth class just registered in REG3166.
entries.prevention: Stop projecting the optional current-ticket field; use only the exact preTicketSelectionCheckpoint.selectedTicketAssessment and the passing execution-authorized MVP gate for final identity proof.

entries.mistake: An inferred 13-path FIX8 source manifest did not reproduce the sealed DC284B6D stable aggregate under either tested terminal-newline convention.
entries.rootCause: The 13 stable owner paths and aggregate algorithm were reconstructed from summary rather than copied from an authoritative manifest owner.
entries.prevention: Do not write or use the inferred list; regenerate the r60.81 build manifest from the exact preserved r60.80 manifest path inventory, rehash every live file, and independently verify count and manifest checksum.

entries.mistake: The first bounded build-process probe matched the build-command marker embedded in its own PowerShell command line and reported one active process.
entries.rootCause: The probe did not exclude the current diagnostic process and its ancestor hosts before applying command-line text matching.
entries.prevention: Exclude the diagnostic process and ancestor hosts, then require a separately identified Flutter, Dart, Java or Gradle child plus registered r60.81 candidate state before classifying a build as active.

entries.mistake: The proposed r60.81 manifest reconstruction reused the preserved r60.80 path inventory and appended only already-known FIX8 paths, which could omit other current tracked or untracked build-affecting inputs.
entries.rootCause: A predecessor inventory was treated as a possible successor input closure despite the intentionally huge dirty worktree and continuing development.
entries.prevention: Before candidate registration or build, derive and seal the complete live tracked and untracked Flutter and Android build-input closure, cross-check the predecessor inventory, fail on every unexplained omission, and bind the exact manifest count and SHA-256 into the candidate gate.

entries.mistake: The coordination gate was invoked with a descriptive custom AgentTask value that has no single active owner claim.
entries.rootCause: The exact durable primary claim name /root was replaced with a human-readable task description at gate time.
entries.prevention: Invoke the coordination gate with AgentTask /root and UseRecordedClaim for the primary task; never invent a gate-time task label.

entries.mistake: The first prebuild evidence patch combined two new files with a coordination-policy owner append and used a stale policy-tail anchor.
entries.rootCause: The mutable coordination-policy tail was not freshly read and verified before it was used as part of a multi-owner patch.
entries.prevention: Create evidence files separately, then read the current policy tail and append their claims with one unique bounded hunk.

entries.mistake: The first MVP release-authorization patch combined exact scalar transitions with a long historical approvalState replacement whose text was not byte-identical to live context.
entries.rootCause: A mutable long narrative value was used as one anchor in a multi-hunk state transition.
entries.prevention: Project each live scalar and replace flags, scopes, ticket hash and narrative state in separate bounded hunks while verifying the execution gates remain closed until all fields agree.

entries.mistake: The first r60.81 manifest was sealed before the listed FIX5 successor lifecycle gate had reached its final prebuild form.
entries.rootCause: Manifest generation was ordered before all build-control owners included in that manifest were finalized.
entries.prevention: Preserve the stale 20260822-01 seal, finalize and pass every listed build control, then create and bind a distinct 20260822-02 live-owner seal without overwrite or reuse.

entries.mistake: The first REG3175 correction patch omitted an Update File boundary before the registry JSON hunk, causing apply_patch to search for registry content inside the manifest generator.
entries.rootCause: A source-script update and registry append were composed without an explicit multifile boundary.
entries.prevention: Apply evidence correction, generator change, memory append and registry append as separate one-file patches with no implicit file transitions.

entries.mistake: REG3174 claimed the finalized FIX5 lifecycle gate was a listed owner in the first r60.81 manifest without projecting exact manifest membership.
entries.rootCause: A category count was treated as proof of one exact control path, and the seven-control generator list omitted several invoked prebuild gates.
entries.prevention: Project exact manifest membership before changed-owner classification and include the full invoked regression, coordination, MVP, motion, FIX5, APK, wrapper, integrity and secure-input control graph in the final generator.

entries.mistake: The final APK gate was launched through nested pwsh with RuntimeDefine supplied as an outer PowerShell string array, so later elements became positional arguments.
entries.rootCause: A PowerShell array object was transported across an executable argument boundary instead of passed directly to the script in-process.
entries.prevention: Invoke check-apk-regression-gate-state.ps1 in the current PowerShell process with the array intact, matching the authoritative build wrapper call semantics.

entries.mistake: The PublicAuth sideload wrapper omitted MOOLSOCIAL_SOCIAL_CONTENT_URL even though the FIX8 Social candidate identity activates that exact required runtime define.
entries.rootCause: The Social endpoint was added to the YouTube review profile but not the PublicAuthSideloadPreflight runtime-value map.
entries.prevention: Add the exact non-secret Dev Social-content URL to the PublicAuth profile, assert it in the control test, reject the 20260822-02 seal and create a distinct live-owner 20260822-03 manifest before the single retry.

entries.mistake: A bounded FIX8 consistency read used nonexistent shorthand MVP and public-readiness state filenames.
entries.rootCause: The live authoritative config owner suffixes were shortened from memory instead of recovered from a config-scoped exact filename inventory.
entries.prevention: Use config/mvp-scope-gate-state.json and config/public-auth-live-provider-readiness-state-c34p-fix5.json for the repeated consistency projection.

entries.mistake: A bounded manifest-membership projection piped directly from a top-level PowerShell foreach statement and was rejected by the parser.
entries.rootCause: Loop output was not first collected into an explicit array before the formatting pipeline.
entries.prevention: Assign the foreach projection to an explicit result array, then serialize that array after the loop.

entries.mistake: A founder-facing copy/paste PowerShell command inserted a path separator before the .ps1 extension of build-buy-device-review.ps1.
entries.rootCause: The script path was transcribed without verifying the final literal command path against the live filesystem.
entries.prevention: Before presenting PowerShell commands, require the exact literal script path to pass Test-Path with PathType Leaf, preserve its filename and extension, and use one ordinary Windows path separator between components.

entries.mistake: The authorized r60.81 wrapper reached assembleRelease before a live release resource-link check proved every referenced Android resource owner existed.
entries.rootCause: Merged release styles reference @drawable/launch_background, the drawable owner is absent, and the pre-APK gate graph lacked an authoritative release resource-link task or complete static reference-owner audit.
entries.prevention: Repair the smallest source-consistent Android resource owner, add a pre-APK resource-integrity gate, prove the exact release resource-processing task clean, reseal all changed build inputs, record the failed build action, and require authority consistent with the one-build limit before another APK attempt.

entries.mistake: A post-failure journal validation guessed preTicketSelectionCheckpoint.selectedTicket.manifestSha256 and returned null.
entries.rootCause: The exact live MVP selected-ticket parent was reconstructed from memory despite REG3166 already requiring bounded parent projection.
entries.prevention: Recover the live parent around the unique FIX8 manifest path before projecting its hash, compare it to the independent ticket checksum, and reject null as invalid evidence.

entries.mistake: The first REG3182 resource search named unproven debug and profile resource directories and returned partial match/error output.
entries.rootCause: Android resource source-set roots were guessed instead of enumerated from the live filesystem before the bounded search.
entries.prevention: Enumerate verified resource roots first, search only existing roots or the bounded app/src parent, and never credit mixed match/error output as a complete audit.

entries.mistake: A recursive Android-intermediate filename projection returned 1,225 lines and was truncated.
entries.rootCause: The diagnostic searched broad merge, packaged and blame trees instead of exact release paths and resource filenames.
entries.prevention: Project only exact launch-background release intermediate paths with bounded existence, timestamp and checksum fields, and inspect exact merge-blame records separately.

entries.mistake: The r60.81 failure journal replaced the schema-bound MVP top-level state with a novel failure label.
entries.rootCause: Action-result truth was overloaded into a contract identity field instead of kept in the protected candidate narrative and dedicated execution authorities.
entries.prevention: Preserve ticket_disclosed_and_authorized at top level while independently closing buildAuthorized and deviceInstallAuthorized and recording failure in the exact action-state owners.

entries.mistake: The new Android resource gate compared base and v21 launch-background XML by raw SHA-256 and rejected a line-ending-only difference.
entries.rootCause: Byte serialization equality was used as a proxy for semantic XML equality.
entries.prevention: Parse both owners as XML and compare normalized XML semantics; use byte equality only for the Gradle packaged copy of the exact base owner.

entries.mistake: After processReleaseResources succeeded and the compiled merge symbol was found, the new gate required one obsolete raw packaged_res base path.
entries.rootCause: An Android Gradle Plugin intermediate directory layout was treated as a stable semantic contract despite qualifier-specific packaging.
entries.prevention: Use native release resource-task exit zero plus the compiled merged launch-background resource as authoritative proof; do not require one raw packaged-resource layout.

entries.mistake: The first source repair restored a tracked drawable-v21 duplicate even though release lint proves it is obsolete at minSdkVersion 24.
entries.rootCause: Stale incremental resource-merge state was conflated with absence of a necessary source qualifier owner; the valid base drawable already existed.
entries.prevention: Preserve the intentional obsolete v21 deletion, require the base owner and min-SDK boundary, allow only that exact tracked resource deletion, and force processReleaseResources with --rerun-tasks before APK assembly.

entries.mistake: Removing the obsolete v21 resource file left its physical resource directory empty, so fresh release lint continued to report ObsoleteSdkInt.
entries.rootCause: The file edit correctly removed the final tracked owner but did not remove the now-empty untracked filesystem directory that Android lint still evaluates.
entries.prevention: Before final lint, verify the exact obsolete qualifier directory is repository-confined and contains zero items, remove only that empty directory without recursion, and reject any nonempty target.

entries.mistake: The exact verified empty drawable-v21 directory removal was submitted through the execution tool and rejected by its safety policy before process creation.
entries.rootCause: This execution context does not permit the required filesystem deletion even when it is nonrecursive, repository-confined and empty.
entries.prevention: Do not bypass the safety denial through another shell; request immediate founder execution of one literal PowerShell removal command and independently verify absence before final lint.

entries.mistake: The first repair source manifest was generated before the included C34P FIX5 lifecycle checker was updated for the repair-qualified authority-pending state.
entries.rootCause: An executable checker included in the build-input closure was incorrectly treated as post-seal state bookkeeping.
entries.prevention: Finish all executable gate and lifecycle-checker edits before sealing, independently verify every manifest row against live bytes, and permanently reject rather than overwrite or reuse any seal with a changed owner.

entries.mistake: A read-only file inventory command piped directly from a foreach statement and PowerShell rejected it with 'An empty pipe element is not allowed'.
entries.rootCause: A compound foreach statement was composed as a pipeline producer without an enclosing expression, instead of using independent scalar reads required by repository policy.
entries.prevention: Use one independent PowerShell command/result per mandatory owner; when aggregation is genuinely required, construct a bounded array before piping and validate syntax before execution.

entries.mistake: The coordination policy Markdown and JSON owners were read together, and the combined tool output truncated before complete independent readback.
entries.rootCause: Parallel latency optimization was incorrectly applied to mandatory owners whose policy requires one independent command/result and complete non-truncated consumption.
entries.prevention: Read every mandatory owner in a separate command/result, page large owners in non-overlapping bounded ranges through verified EOF, and reject any truncated result before relying on it.

entries.mistake: A JavaScript execution wrapper for a bounded PowerShell checker-source locator was rejected with 'SyntaxError: Unexpected string' before the nested command ran.
entries.rootCause: An inline wrapper containing a dense quoted PowerShell expression was not first reduced to the simplest validated tool-call form.
entries.prevention: Use one plain awaited tool call with a simple literal command and plain output projection; split pattern locators from source reads and never infer that a wrapper parse failure executed PowerShell.

entries.mistake: The shared public-authentication gate rejected the fresh authorized FIX8 repair-retry lifecycle because its successor binding ended at the repair-qualified authority-pending state.
entries.rootCause: The new action-time retry authority was added to the release lifecycle gate without auditing every inherited shared-auth gate for the same exact successor transition.
entries.prevention: Before sealing a retry candidate, replay every inherited auth gate against both repair-pending and fresh retry-authorized fixtures, add only the exact held-authority transition, and reseal all changed executable gate owners before build.

entries.mistake: A bounded shared-auth checker source read returned a tool-level context-truncation result, so its apparent source output was not accepted as complete evidence.
entries.rootCause: The requested source slice and tool output allowance were still too broad for the active conversation context.
entries.prevention: After registering any truncated read, locate one exact literal anchor first and read only the smallest independently bounded source slice required for the decision; never infer completeness from truncated output.

entries.mistake: A read-only registry inspection queried a nonexistent regressions collection and failed before returning the last entry.
entries.rootCause: The query assumed the registry collection name instead of using its established entries property.
entries.prevention: Inspect or retain the registry top-level schema before indexing and use the exact entries property for bounded last-entry readback; register a failed query before correcting it.

entries.mistake: A post-edit FIX8 ticket projection queried a nonexistent sourceQualification subobject and returned null manifest fields, so that projection was rejected as readback evidence.
entries.rootCause: The readback command assumed the manifest-owning subobject instead of locating its established property name first.
entries.prevention: Locate the exact manifest property with a literal bounded search before projecting its parent object, and reject null or ambiguous projections rather than inferring a successful state update.

entries.mistake: A post-edit APK gate state projection queried a wrong manifest-owning subobject and returned null manifest fields, so that projection was rejected as readback evidence.
entries.rootCause: The readback command reused an assumed state-object path instead of locating the exact manifest property parent in the current JSON schema.
entries.prevention: For every state owner, locate the exact property with a bounded literal search before projection, then parse and compare the established parent fields without accepting null results.

entries.mistake: A read-only Get-Help lookup used a nonexistent check-mvp-scope-gate.ps1 filename and failed to return the MVP gate parameters.
entries.rootCause: The checker filename was assumed from its conceptual name instead of being resolved from the scripts directory first.
entries.prevention: Resolve exact checker paths with rg --files before Get-Help or invocation, and register a failed lookup before retrying with the discovered filename.

entries.mistake: The first post-resource-link non-emitting git-status digest completed with exit zero but returned non-empty stderr and a large unexpected record-count expansion, so its digest was not accepted as authoritative.
entries.rootCause: The raw status capture did not separately classify stderr or distinguish repository evidence from newly materialized ignored-or-unignored Gradle intermediates before reporting a single digest result.
entries.prevention: Register any non-empty stderr or abrupt dirty-record expansion before retry; classify counts without emitting paths or credential values, preserve all files, and accept a digest only with exit zero and empty stderr.

entries.mistake: The authorized r60.81 wrapper rejected the intended repository-local artifact directory as outside the production repository before Gradle started.
entries.rootCause: The wrapper passed a repository-relative artifact target directly to IO.Path.GetFullPath, which resolves against the process-level .NET current directory; that directory can remain C:\WINDOWS\system32 even when the PowerShell location and prompt are inside the repository.
entries.prevention: Centralize canonical descendant-path validation, test existing and not-yet-created repo-local targets plus prefix-collision and traversal negatives, and require the same verified helper in every APK and AAB artifact-producing wrapper before any build action.

entries.mistake: A read-only build-state poll slept for the same duration as its tool yield boundary and returned no projected output while the wrapper omitted any returned session identifier.
entries.rootCause: The poll command used a 30-second sleep with a 30-second yield and projected only stdout instead of also preserving session_id when the nested command yielded.
entries.prevention: Use a sleep shorter than the tool yield and always project either final output and exit code or the returned session identifier; register an ambiguous poll before any corrected poll.

entries.mistake: The authorized r60.81 release APK assembled successfully, but the post-build production plugin-integrity gate rejected it because io.flutter.plugins.firebase.core.FlutterFirebaseCorePlugin was not found.
entries.rootCause: The post-build gate searched unmapped apkanalyzer class output for the original Firebase Core plugin name, while R8 had renamed that class; the current mapping-aware defined-class output proves the registrant, Firebase Core and MainActivity are present and integration_test is absent.
entries.prevention: Require mapping-aware, defined-only multidex inspection for every minified APK and mapped-Dex inspection for every AAB before copy, seal or sideload; exercise positive, missing-class, missing-mapping and forbidden-integration_test fixtures before every build workflow.

entries.mistake: A read-only apkanalyzer dex packages diagnostic used --help; the tool printed its option table but then rejected help as an unrecognized option.
entries.rootCause: The diagnostic assumed GNU-style subcommand help support instead of using the analyzer's established command syntax or already displayed supported options.
entries.prevention: Do not invoke apkanalyzer dex packages with --help; use only its displayed supported options such as --defined-only and mapping inputs, and register any nonzero diagnostic before a corrected invocation.

entries.mistake: A multi-file REG3205 evidence correction omitted the second Update File header, so apply_patch searched for document prose in the registry JSON and rejected the patch atomically.
entries.rootCause: Two file-specific hunks were composed under one file header instead of declaring an explicit Update File boundary for each owner.
entries.prevention: Use one explicit Update File header per owner in every multi-file patch, verify patch boundaries before execution, and rely on atomic rejection rather than inferring any partial edit.

entries.mistake: A REG3205 correction readback used a relative array index and selected REG3204, so the displayed root cause did not verify the intended incident.
entries.rootCause: The verification assumed the target incident's position relative to the registry tail after new entries had been appended.
entries.prevention: Select registry evidence by exact incident ID for every readback and reject positional indexing whenever entries can be appended concurrently in the same task.

entries.mistake: The r60.81 release build emitted obsolete source-manifest package namespace warnings for 14 third-party Android plugins; these were visible only during Gradle execution rather than blocked in preflight.
entries.rootCause: The resolved third-party plugin set still contains AndroidManifest.xml package attributes that AGP ignores, and no prebuild inventory gate blocked future packaging while that migration debt remained.
entries.prevention: Inventory resolved Android plugin manifests before every APK or AAB build, block packaging while any obsolete package namespace declaration remains, migrate only through repository dependency upgrades or overrides, and never patch the machine Pub cache in place.

entries.mistake: The first resumed coordination readback queried nonexistent regressionRegistry and activeTasks properties and returned null or zero values, so it did not prove the current policy binding.
entries.rootCause: The readback assumed prior schema labels instead of first projecting the policy root property names and then selecting registryBinding and activeClaims.
entries.prevention: Project root property names first, then read only registryBinding plus bounded exact task/owner flags; reject null readback fields and never infer the policy schema.

entries.mistake: A resumed MVP-state projection serialized the complete preTicketSelectionCheckpoint object, enumerated historical assessments and produced truncated output.
entries.rootCause: The command assigned the whole checkpoint object instead of constructing the required bounded checkpointId, path, sha256, state, currentTicketId and selectedTicketAssessment projection.
entries.prevention: Construct the exact bounded checkpoint projection explicitly, never serialize the whole checkpoint or historical assessment members, and reject every truncated MVP-state result.

entries.mistake: A registry schema projection again placed statement-form if directly inside PSCustomObject property values and PowerShell rejected the command before execution.
entries.rootCause: The existing REG2960 rule to compute conditional values as scalars before object construction was not applied to the resumed diagnostic.
entries.prevention: Compute every conditional scalar before PSCustomObject construction; do not place statement-form if in a property value, and register any parser rejection before a corrected command.

entries.mistake: A coordination readback serialized every active task and its full owner list, producing dense truncated output instead of the exact root task and required owner flags.
entries.rootCause: The readback projected activeClaims wholesale instead of selecting the one /root claim and bounded boolean ownership checks.
entries.prevention: Project registryBinding, release serialization scalars and only the exact current task with owner count plus named owner-presence booleans; prohibit full activeClaims serialization.

entries.mistake: REG3209 referenced check-android-plugin-manifest-namespace-readiness.ps1 before that gate file existed, so the mandatory regression-memory checker stopped the next implementation action.
entries.rootCause: The incident entry was appended before its machine-detectable prevention owner was created, violating the registry's requirement that every referenced gate and evidence path already exist.
entries.prevention: Create and parse the prevention owner before appending an incident that references it, or initially bind only existing fail-closed gates and strengthen the entry after the new gate exists; replay memory before further action.

entries.mistake: A parallel non-emitting dirty-digest command crossed its yield boundary, but the orchestration projected only output and exit code and dropped the returned session identifier.
entries.rootCause: The resumed orchestration repeated REG3204 by not preserving session_id for every potentially yielding nested exec result.
entries.prevention: Run the dirty digest as a standalone command with a sufficient initial yield, preserve session_id explicitly, resume only that exact session when returned, and accept only a terminal exit with empty stderr.

entries.mistake: The first plugin-manifest namespace inventory counted the direct integration_test development plugin and reported 15 obsolete manifests although the release Gradle transcript processed 14.
entries.rootCause: The initial gate treated every Android entry in .flutter-plugins-dependencies as a release dependency and did not exclude direct dev_dependencies before evaluating release packaging readiness.
entries.prevention: Derive direct dev-only package names from the repository pubspec, exclude them from namespace readiness, assert the release inventory matches the 14 observed release plugins, and retain the separate artifact-integrity ban on integration_test bytecode.

entries.mistake: A follow-up plugin diagnostic treated dependencyGraph as an object keyed by plugin name and returned an array of nulls plus array implementation properties.
entries.rootCause: The generated dependencyGraph shape was assumed instead of projecting its type and one bounded element before selecting an exact plugin entry.
entries.prevention: Project generated JSON node type and one bounded element before schema-specific filtering; select array entries by their exact name field and reject null projections.

entries.mistake: The first apk_recovery_audit claim readback indexed owners after PowerShell had scalarized the single-owner collection, returning the first character 'a' instead of the path.
entries.rootCause: The readback used $c.owners[0] without first materializing @($c[0].owners), so single-item collection unrolling changed array indexing into string-character indexing.
entries.prevention: Materialize the exact task object and its owners with @() before indexing, assert task count and owner count separately, and reject any readback that does not equal the complete literal owner path.

entries.mistake: The read-only Android warning audit projected problemsReport.problemSummaries and received one structurally empty row even though the bounded retained report contained summary objects elsewhere.
entries.rootCause: The diagnostics report node shape was assumed from a conceptual label instead of projecting exact node types and bounded property names before selecting summary entries.
entries.prevention: After refreshed generation, inspect only exact node types and bounded property names, locate the literal summary owner, reject empty identifiers/counts, and never infer warning classification from a null projection.

entries.mistake: The primary resumed android_warning_audit with shorthand REG3219 instead of its required literal full registry ID and evidence path; the subagent guessed a full ID, found zero matches and stopped.
entries.rootCause: The resume message omitted the policy-required literal incident identity even though it supplied the refreshed generation.
entries.prevention: Every stopped-subagent resume must include the exact full regression ID, exact evidence path, refreshed registry count/SHA and permitted next action; subagents must never expand shorthand or guess an ID.

entries.mistake: The primary added the planned postbuild recovery script to its recorded claim before creating the file, so the coordination gate rejected the missing owner.
entries.rootCause: The existing REG3214 ordering rule was not applied to a new claimed prevention/recovery owner: the policy claim was patched before the file existed.
entries.prevention: Create a new primary-owned script with apply_patch before adding it to the recorded claim when bootstrap rules permit, or use only an already-existing claimed owner for the first bounded creation; never gate a claim that names a missing file.

entries.mistake: The one authorized adb install -r command reached its Success line and completed post-install version extraction, but the final PSCustomObject receipt used bare true/false tokens and PowerShell exited 1 after the device mutation.
entries.rootCause: The receipt projection repeated the durable PowerShell rule that booleans must be $true/$false, placing command tokens in object values after the irreversible install boundary.
entries.prevention: Construct and parser-test the complete receipt projection before adb mutation, use only $true/$false boolean literals, journal install attempt count before execution, never repeat an install after a post-mutation receipt failure, and classify the result through read-only installed package/version readback.

entries.mistake: The one r60.81 cold-start command returned Status ok with a live process, app surface and clean crash/plugin/Firebase-init counts, but LaunchState was UNKNOWN, TotalTime was absent and the first activity-focus parser returned false.
entries.rootCause: The receipt assumed one Android am/dumpsys output shape and treated absent timing plus newer focus labels as ordinary scalar values instead of an incomplete qualification boundary.
entries.prevention: Never relaunch after an incomplete receipt; register it, preserve the one action count, use read-only current-window/activity/process checks with all known Android label variants, and claim cold-start qualification only when focus and visible app ownership are authoritative.

entries.mistake: The first Kotlin-plugin readiness gate embedded backslash-escaped double quotes inside PowerShell double-quoted regular expressions, causing a parser rejection.
entries.rootCause: The regex used JavaScript-style backslash quote escaping, but PowerShell does not escape double quotes with backslash.
entries.prevention: Use PowerShell single-quoted regex literals with doubled embedded single quotes or precomputed regex scalars, parser-test the gate before invocation, and never integrate an unparsed gate into APK/AAB wrappers.

entries.mistake: The Kotlin-gate validation command continued after ScriptBlock.Create and invocation errors, then emitted ParserPassed=true and exited zero despite the parser failure.
entries.rootCause: The validator did not set ErrorActionPreference=Stop or assert parser success before constructing its result object, allowing later output to mask nonterminating errors.
entries.prevention: Set ErrorActionPreference=Stop in every parser validator, perform parsing as the sole first assertion, emit a pass object only after successful parse and behavior checks, and reject any result that includes preceding error records.

entries.mistake: A bounded attempt to strengthen REG1328 and REG1595 assumed multiline raw gate-array formatting from a ConvertTo-Json projection, so apply_patch rejected the context atomically.
entries.rootCause: The patch used serialized projection formatting rather than locating the literal raw registry lines before editing the existing entries.
entries.prevention: Locate exact raw entry line ranges first, patch only literal existing formatting, preserve atomic rejection as zero partial change, and read back both exact IDs before updating registry generation.

entries.mistake: The first FIX8 r60.81 qualification document transcribed the exact speech_to_text plugin name as speech_to_test.
entries.rootCause: The plugin name was manually retyped instead of copied from the qualified three-plugin inventory output.
entries.prevention: Copy exact dependency identifiers from machine inventory output, compare the durable evidence list against the gate inventory before qualification, and register any transcription before correction.

entries.mistake: On installed r60.81, the founder tapped Google and MoolSocial reported that sign-in was not completed instead of completing the global login journey.
entries.rootCause: Pending sanitized diagnosis; the failure may be provider-specific or in the shared post-provider Firebase/session completion boundary and must not be guessed from generic customer copy.
entries.prevention: Do not retry the provider or rebuild; preserve the device failure, classify sanitized runtime readiness and exact failure code, select the smallest root-cause repair, and require focused plus shared post-login tests before any separately authorized successor build.

entries.mistake: On installed r60.81, the founder tapped YouTube and MoolSocial reported that sign-in was not completed instead of completing the shared Google identity journey.
entries.rootCause: Pending sanitized diagnosis; YouTube reuses Google identity, but its failure remains separately traceable until the shared gateway and exact YouTube return are classified.
entries.prevention: Do not retry or relabel Google evidence as YouTube success; classify the shared identity boundary and exact YouTube completion path, then require independent Google and YouTube acceptance tests before a separately authorized successor build.

entries.mistake: On installed r60.81, the founder tapped Facebook and MoolSocial reported that sign-in was not completed instead of completing native public-profile login.
entries.rootCause: Pending sanitized diagnosis; the generic customer message does not prove whether native provider return, Firebase credential exchange or shared session completion failed.
entries.prevention: Do not retry the provider; classify only sanitized native/Firebase/shared completion facts, preserve public_profile-only scope, and require focused native return plus shared post-login tests before any successor build.

entries.mistake: On installed r60.81, the founder tapped Instagram and MoolSocial reported that sign-in was not completed instead of completing professional-account OAuth login.
entries.rootCause: Pending sanitized diagnosis; the generic customer message does not identify browser launch, callback, broker, Firebase token or shared session completion as the failing stage.
entries.prevention: Do not retry; classify sanitized readiness and callback-stage evidence, preserve professional-account eligibility and exact scope, then require cold/foreground callback plus shared post-login tests before any successor build.

entries.mistake: On installed r60.81, the founder tapped X and MoolSocial reported that sign-in was not completed instead of completing OAuth 2.0 PKCE login.
entries.rootCause: Pending sanitized diagnosis; the generic customer message does not identify browser launch, callback, broker, Firebase custom token or shared session completion as the failing stage.
entries.prevention: Do not retry; classify sanitized readiness and callback-stage evidence, preserve exact PKCE and minimum scopes, then require cold/foreground callback plus shared post-login tests before any successor build.

entries.mistake: The primary expanded android_warning_audit to current auth source/test owners already held by the active primary claim, so the mandatory coordination gate rejected the overlap before the subagent read any auth source.
entries.rootCause: The bounded parallel diagnostic was assigned by adding overlapping owners instead of selecting a non-overlapping evidence owner or keeping the source trace with the existing primary owner.
entries.prevention: Never add a subagent claim until exact active-owner overlap is checked; retain shared auth source diagnosis with the primary and delegate only an already non-overlapping evidence surface.

entries.mistake: A bounded runtime-profile search included a guessed nested build wrapper path and guessed 03-build-provenance.json name that do not exist, so rg emitted two path errors while still returning other matches.
entries.rootCause: The diagnostic reused display/invocation labels instead of first enumerating the exact current wrapper and r60.81 evidence filenames.
entries.prevention: Enumerate exact repository and artifact filenames with rg --files or Get-ChildItem before content search; reject mixed success/error output and never infer runtime provenance from partial matches.

entries.mistake: A bounded auth-test search passed a wildcard as a literal Windows path and named a guessed v5 test file that does not exist, so rg returned path errors alongside a valid older Screen 03 match.
entries.rootCause: The search did not enumerate the exact current test filenames before applying content globs with rg --glob.
entries.prevention: Enumerate exact tests first; pass directories plus rg --glob patterns rather than wildcard path arguments; reject any mixed output containing path errors before drawing a coverage conclusion.

entries.mistake: A sanitized r60.81 runtime readback assumed top-level runtimeDefines/runtimeProfile properties and produced empty flags plus false required-input presence even though the state visibly stores runtime data under another schema node.
entries.rootCause: The command projected assumed property names without first enumerating the bounded top-level and runtime-owner property names.
entries.prevention: Read bounded JSON property names and node types before schema-specific runtime projection; reject an all-empty projection and never treat it as evidence that compiled defines were absent.

entries.mistake: Screen 03 v5 treats every false result from JourneySession.signInWithSocial as a failure and opens the sign-in-was-not-completed recovery sheet even when X or Instagram successfully opened the secure browser and the session is correctly authorizationPending.
entries.rootCause: The UI action boundary checks only completed/isReady and does not distinguish SocialAuthState.pending plus its secure-browser notice from cancelled or failed outcomes; existing callback tests stop at the session layer and do not exercise the v5 provider-tap presentation.
entries.prevention: Keep browser-open authorization pending as a non-failure state, show no retry recovery sheet while the provider owns the foreground, add focused v5 widget coverage for X and Instagram pending starts, and retain separate cancelled/failed recovery coverage.

entries.mistake: The one authorized warm foreground action returned Android Status ok, but the immediate readback did not show com.moolsocial.app owning focus.
entries.rootCause: Pending read-only focus classification; the app may have preserved or re-opened an external provider/browser surface, and Status ok alone cannot qualify the visible app state.
entries.prevention: Do not repeat the start action; classify only the current focused owner category and pending broker state, then require exact app focus before any public UI tap or screenshot.

entries.mistake: The first REG3238 registration patch mistyped the existing apple_instagram test path with a hyphen, so apply_patch rejected the context atomically.
entries.rootCause: The registration patch was composed from memory instead of copying the literal last-entry context from the registry.
entries.prevention: Read the exact bounded registry tail and copy its literal context before appending incidents; treat atomic rejection as zero partial change and register it before retry.

entries.mistake: The bounded post-REG3238 focus classifier queried dumpsys window windows for mCurrentFocus/mFocusedApp and received no matching lines, leaving the current owner category UnknownEmpty while the MoolSocial process remained alive.
entries.rootCause: The query assumed this OPPO Android build exposes current focus under the windows subcommand and those two labels; the earlier cold-start audit already proved focus labels vary by build.
